<!--
  Phase-11 "key numbers" report — DISPLAY ONLY.

  This notebook mirrors the derivation/plotting split the repo already enforces
  for figures: analysis/09b_postprocess_results.R DERIVES the report_*
  artefacts under generated_data/results/<tag>/, and this notebook only READS
  them (via results_require(), the same contract 10_manuscript_figures.R uses)
  and renders kable tables. It never touches a fit, a particle filter, or a raw
  dataset. All numbers are stored NUMERIC in the artefacts; the formatters,
  table shaping and emission live in analysis/utils/results_report.R. The one
  exception to "summaries come from 09": the Section 1 gtsummary tables
  summarise and test 09's per-outbreak rows (report_dataset$outbreaks) at
  render time.

  Structure: Sections 1-5 are the manuscript headline numbers in the order of
  the manuscript; "Supplementary tables" keeps every other table and the
  S-numbered CSVs.

  Reporting conventions:
    * every estimate with its 95% interval; a number that has none by
      construction (an observed count, a posterior / replicate classification,
      a skill score) says so
    * modelling outputs (BRMS effect sizes)  -> posterior median + 95% CrI
    * attributable fraction / number / ratio of means -> adjusted posterior
      median + 95% posterior interval (results.af_posterior), else the replicate
      means + 95% paired bootstrap
    * simulation outputs (smoothing/forecast) -> median + 95% (q025/q975)
    * observed descriptors -> median [IQR]

  Number-formatting convention:
    * case / onset counts -> nearest 10 below 1,000, nearest 100 at or above
    * IRR / hazard ratio / ratio of means -> 2 digits
    * shares and AF -> whole percent (population shares 1 digit)
    * populations -> millions, 1 digit

  Every emitted table gets an automatic "Table N." label, numbered in
  document order.

  If any artefact is missing or stale, results_require() stops with the exact
    Rscript analysis/09b_postprocess_results.R -C <config>
  command that regenerates it.
-->

```{r}
#| label: root
#| include: false
# quarto runs a document in its own directory (analysis/); the sourced modules
# use project-root-relative paths, so pin knitr's working directory to the
# project root (the dir containing analysis/utils/results_core.R).
.find_root <- function() {
  # CHOLERA_PROJECT_ROOT pins it explicitly (the synthetic sandbox, whose
  # analysis/ is a symlink that normalizePath() would follow back to the repo).
  env <- Sys.getenv("CHOLERA_PROJECT_ROOT")
  if (nzchar(env)) return(normalizePath(env))
  d <- normalizePath(getwd())
  while (!file.exists(file.path(d, "analysis/utils/results_core.R"))) {
    parent <- dirname(d)
    if (identical(parent, d)) stop("project root not found from ", getwd())
    d <- parent
  }
  d
}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = .find_root())
```

```{r}
#| label: init
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr); library(tibble); library(stringr); library(tidyr)
  library(knitr); library(kableExtra); library(qs2); library(yaml)
})

# results_core.R: makeResultsRunFile(), results_require(), RESULTS_SCHEMA, the
# registries, enso_conds_named() (via figures_cb). deploy_core.R: so a set
# results.deploy_config resolves exactly as in 09/10. results_report.R: the
# formatters, report_wide(), report_emit_html(), report_loader().
for (.m in c("results_core", "deploy_core", "results_report"))
  source(file.path("analysis/utils", paste0(.m, ".R")))

# Resolve the config the way 09 and 10 do, so RES is the block 09 stamped.
CONFIG_PATH <- params$config_path
# capture.output(): make_options_from_config() cat()s its "Setting default" lines.
invisible(utils::capture.output(
  opt <- suppressMessages(make_options_from_config(option_list = list(),
                                                   cli_argv = c("--config", CONFIG_PATH),
                                                   model = NULL))))
RES         <- opt$results
MAIN_SET    <- as.character(RES$scope$main_set)
FIG1_TRACKS <- as.character(RES$scope$fig1_tracks)
SETS        <- resolve_results_sets(RES)
LV          <- report_levels(RES)   # region / cond / scope / scenario(sets) orderings
AF_POST     <- isTRUE(RES$af_posterior)

.table_n <- report_table_counter()
# Every table is also written as CSV under results.style.tables_dir (one file
# per table, "<NN>_<slug>.csv"; the Data S1 ones are slugged "D<n>_...").
# Cleared first: table numbers shift when sections change.
TABLES_DIR <- RES$style$tables_dir %||% ""
if (nzchar(TABLES_DIR)) {
  dir.create(TABLES_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  unlink(list.files(TABLES_DIR, "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE))
}
# Data release (results.style.data_release): at the end of the report
# every D / T CSV is also copied into <tables_dir>/supp_data/ or
# <tables_dir>/github/ with a manifest (chunk data-release). Captions are
# collected here by slug as the tables are emitted.
# Unset in the config -> the default map of get_default_options() (config.R).
DATA_RELEASE <- RES$style[["data_release"]] %||% get_default_options()$results$style$data_release
# Table slugs withheld from the release (results.style.data_release_exclude).
DATA_RELEASE_EXCLUDE <- unlist(RES$style[["data_release_exclude"]] %||%
                                 get_default_options()$results$style$data_release_exclude)
.CAPTIONS <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
note_caption <- function(slug, cap) if (!is.null(slug) && nzchar(slug)) assign(slug, cap, envir = .CAPTIONS)
# Group display labels (results.style.group_labels): the
# artefacts store group ids and the sidecar's short names; "lag" prints them as
# classes lettered by the deployed occurrence lag (group_labels artefact),
# "centroid" by the sidecar's centroid names ("West [GW]", short "GW"),
# "registry" leaves every table as before. Applied in emit() and in every CSV
# writer (report_write_csv() is wrapped below).
GROUP_LABEL_MODE <- as.character(RES$style[["group_labels"]] %||% "registry")
.mp <- as.character(RES$inputs$manifest %||% "")
GROUP_META <- results_group_meta(if (nzchar(.mp) && file.exists(.mp)) list(MAN = yaml::read_yaml(.mp)) else NULL)
R0_ <- report_loader(opt, CONFIG_PATH, RES)
GROUP_DISP <- group_display_meta(
  GROUP_META, if (identical(GROUP_LABEL_MODE, "lag")) R0_("results_group_labels")$groups else NULL,
  GROUP_LABEL_MODE)
relab <- function(df, cols = NULL) relabel_groups(df, GROUP_DISP, cols)
# Under "centroid" the region / scope orderings follow the display order (GW,
# GG, GH, GE, GS) instead of the sidecar order; other modes are unchanged.
if (identical(GROUP_LABEL_MODE, "centroid")) {
  LV$region <- unname(GROUP_META$short[GROUP_DISP$order])
  LV$scope  <- c("Africa", LV$region)
}
.report_write_csv_raw <- report_write_csv
report_write_csv <- function(df, path) .report_write_csv_raw(relab(df), path)
# A group's short display token: the id without "enso_" under "registry" (as
# before), the class short label ("A −6") under "lag", "GW" under "centroid".
grp_token <- function(id) if (!identical(GROUP_LABEL_MODE, "registry")) unname(GROUP_DISP$short[id]) else sub("^enso_", "", id)
# Membership certainty of the deployed classes (report_membership):
# p_max = a country's largest posterior class probability in the deployed
# sweep cell; "†" below style.membership_low. NULL when results.kl_sweep_dir /
# kl_sweep_cell are unset (no p_max columns).
MB <- if (nzchar(RES$kl_sweep_dir %||% "") && nzchar(RES[["kl_sweep_cell"]] %||% ""))
  R0_("results_report_membership") else NULL
MB_LOW <- as.numeric(RES$style[["membership_low"]] %||% 0.6)
pmax_lab <- function(iso3) {
  p <- stats::setNames(MB$country$p_max, MB$country$iso3)[as.character(iso3)]
  ifelse(is.na(p), "—", sprintf("%.2f%s", p, ifelse(p < MB_LOW, "†", "")))
}
# "n / median p_max" of a group, from its id or its stored short name.
grp_pmax_lab <- function(g) {
  g <- as.character(g)
  id <- ifelse(g %in% GROUP_META$order, g, names(GROUP_META$short)[match(g, GROUP_META$short)])
  x <- MB$group[match(id, MB$group$group), , drop = FALSE]
  ifelse(is.na(x$group), "—", sprintf("%d / %.2f", x$n_hard, x$p_max_median))
}
# Add a p_max column (by country) or an "n / median p_max" column (by group) to
# a table about to be emitted; unchanged without report_membership.
with_pmax <- function(df, col, by = c("country", "group")) {
  by <- match.arg(by)
  if (is.null(MB) || is.null(df) || !nrow(df)) return(df)
  if (by == "country") df[["p_max"]] <- pmax_lab(df[[col]])
  else df[["n / median p_max"]] <- grp_pmax_lab(df[[col]])
  df
}
# with_afro() / AFRO_COL / AFRO_NOTE: the WHO-AFRO subregion column (utils/results_report.R).
# A printed table: relabelled values, and the "ENSO group" header says what
# the labels are under "lag".
relab_tab <- function(df) {
  df <- relab(df)
  if (!is.null(df) && identical(GROUP_LABEL_MODE, "lag"))
    names(df)[names(df) == "ENSO group"] <- "ENSO lag class"
  df
}
emit <- function(df, cap, pack_by = NULL, slug = NULL, raw = NULL) {
  if (identical(pack_by, "ENSO group") && identical(GROUP_LABEL_MODE, "lag")) pack_by <- "ENSO lag class"
  if (!is.null(df) && AFRO_COL %in% names(df) && any(grepl("‡", df[[AFRO_COL]], fixed = TRUE)))
    cap <- paste(cap, AFRO_NOTE)
  note_caption(slug, cap)
  report_emit_html(relab_tab(df), cap, pack_by, .table_n, slug = slug, csv_dir = TABLES_DIR, raw = relab(raw))
}
# A gtsummary table, numbered and written as CSV like emit(). gtsummary is
# optional: without it the Section 1
# summaries and tests are skipped with a note.
HAS_GT <- requireNamespace("gtsummary", quietly = TRUE)
emit_gt <- function(tbl, cap, slug = NULL) {
  note_caption(slug, cap)
  n <- .table_n()
  if (nzchar(TABLES_DIR))
    report_write_csv(gtsummary::as_tibble(tbl, col_labels = TRUE),
                     file.path(TABLES_DIR, report_csv_name(n, cap, slug)))
  k <- gtsummary::as_kable_extra(tbl, format = "html", escape = FALSE,
                                 caption = sprintf("Table %d. %s", n, cap)) |>
    kableExtra::kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                              full_width = FALSE, position = "left")
  # gtsummary escapes "<" in its p-values once more than kable expects.
  cat(gsub("&amp;lt;", "&lt;", as.character(k), fixed = TRUE), "\n\n")
}
R_   <- report_loader(opt, CONFIG_PATH, RES)
# ENSO condition labels are shortened for display ("La Niña (−2.0)" -> "(−2)").
cond_fct <- function(x) factor(short_enso(x), levels = LV$cond)
.has <- function(v, x) isTRUE(length(x) == 1L && any(abs(v - as.numeric(x)) < 1e-9))
bold <- function(x) paste0("**", x, "**")
# Bold (raw HTML) when a 95% interval excludes 0 (AF, AN).
bold0 <- function(txt, lo, hi) ifelse(!is.na(lo) & !is.na(hi) & (lo > 0 | hi < 0),
                                      paste0("<strong>", txt, "</strong>"), txt)
fmt_irr <- function(m, lo, hi) fmt_ratio_bold(m, lo, hi, 2)
# AF / AN with their interval; the point alone where the artefact has none
# (e.g. the paired bootstrap with attrib_boot_b = 0).
.no_ci  <- function(lo, hi) is.na(lo) & is.na(hi)
.nz     <- function(x) gsub("(^|[ (])-0%", "\\10%", x)   # "-0%" -> "0%"
fmt_af  <- function(m, lo, hi) .nz(ifelse(.no_ci(lo, hi), fmt_pct(m), bold0(fmt_pct_ci(m, lo, hi, 0), lo, hi)))
fmt_an  <- function(metric, m, lo, hi) ifelse(.no_ci(lo, hi),
  ifelse(metric == "onsets", fmt_int(m), fmt_cases(m)),
  bold0(ifelse(metric == "onsets", fmt_ci_int(m, lo, hi), fmt_ci_cases(m, lo, hi)), lo, hi))
scope_lab <- function(level, region) ifelse(level == "continent", "Africa", as.character(region))
scope_fct <- function(x) factor(x, levels = unique(c(LV$scope, sort(unique(as.character(x))))))
```

This report is keyed to config **`r CONFIG_PATH`** (deploy
`r RES$deploy_config %||% "—"`; analog sets: `r paste(SETS, collapse = ", ")`;
main counterfactual set: **`r MAIN_SET`**). Every estimate comes with its 95%
interval; numbers without one (observed counts, classifications, skill scores)
are marked as such.

# 1 — Description of observations

```{r}
#| label: r1-load
d  <- R_("results_report_dataset")
rc <- d$raw_counts
cv <- d$coverage
cn <- setNames(d$counts$value, d$counts$metric)
```

Observed counts (no uncertainty interval); distributions as median [IQR].
National-level (ADM0) outbreaks are excluded throughout.

- **Raw outbreak set** (all outbreaks extracted from the time-series database,
  African countries): **`r fmt_int(rc$n_outbreaks)` outbreaks** in
  **`r fmt_int(rc$n_locations)` locations** across
  **`r fmt_int(rc$n_countries)` countries**
  (`r fmt_cases(rc$n_suspected_cases)` suspected cases).
- **Analysis dataset**: **`r fmt_int(cv$n_gids_panel)` locations** in
  **`r fmt_int(cv$n_countries_panel)` countries**;
  **`r fmt_int(cv$n_location_months_panel)` location-months** at risk
  (`r format(cv$date_min, "%b %Y")` – `r format(cv$date_max, "%b %Y")`);
  **`r fmt_pop(cv$total_pop_covered, 1)` people** covered in
  `r cv$pop_ref_year` (`r fmt_int(cv$n_adm1_covered)` ADM1 units, observed
  sub-unit population).
- **Outbreaks in the analysis dataset**: **`r fmt_int(cn[["n_outbreaks"]])`**
  (canonical episodes) in `r fmt_int(cn[["n_gids"]])` locations,
  `r fmt_cases(cn[["n_suspected_cases"]])` suspected cases. The analysis
  dataset has ADM1 and ADM2 locations only (no ADM3).

```{r}
#| label: r1
#| results: asis
emit(d$raw_table1 |> transmute(
       `Admin level`                    = admin_level,
       Outbreaks                        = fmt_int(n_outbreaks),
       Locations                        = fmt_int(n_locations),
       Countries                        = fmt_int(n_countries),
       `Total cases`                    = fmt_cases(total_cases),
       `Cases, median [IQR]`            = fmt_iqr(cases_med, cases_q25, cases_q75, fmt_int),
       `Duration (weeks), median [IQR]` = fmt_iqr(dur_wk_med, dur_wk_q25, dur_wk_q75, fmt_num, digits = 1),
       `Population (thousands), median [IQR]` = fmt_iqr(pop_med / 1e3, pop_q25 / 1e3, pop_q75 / 1e3, fmt_int),
       `Attack rate /1,000, median [IQR]` = fmt_iqr(ar_med, ar_q25, ar_q75, fmt_num, digits = 2)),
     "Raw outbreak set: outbreak descriptors by admin level (Zheng et al. 2022 layout; ADM0 excluded)",
     slug = "outbreaks_raw_by_level", raw = d$raw_table1)

# Data S1 / GitHub, D35: the analysis set by admin level
# (report_dataset$table1, the same layout on the analysis outbreak set; ADM0
# excluded; duration months from the duration panel's episodes).
emit(report_analysis_set_table(d$table1),
     "Analysis set: outbreak descriptors by admin level (Zheng et al. 2022 layout; ADM0 excluded; D35)",
     slug = "D35_analysis_set_by_level",
     raw = if (!is.null(d$table1)) d$table1[as.character(d$table1$admin_level) != "ADM0", , drop = FALSE])

# GitHub, D35b / D35c (supplementary tables S2 and S3): the same
# descriptors by admin level (incl. All) and outbreaks by season-year ENSO
# state, for Africa and each WHO-AFRO subregion (report_dataset v5).
emit(report_analysis_set_region_table(d$table1_region),
     "Analysis set: outbreak descriptors by admin level, Africa and WHO-AFRO subregion (SOM and SDN under Eastern Africa; D35b)",
     pack_by = "region", slug = "D35b_analysis_set_by_level_region", raw = d$table1_region)
emit(report_enso_region_table(d$enso_region, d$enso_region_p),
     "Analysis set: outbreaks by season-year ENSO state, Africa and WHO-AFRO subregion (share of the block's outbreaks; Kruskal-Wallis p across the three states, unadjusted; D35c)",
     pack_by = "region", slug = "D35c_outbreaks_by_enso_region",
     raw = report_enso_region_table(d$enso_region, d$enso_region_p, raw = TRUE))

ENSO_STATES <- c("La Niña", "Neutral", "El Niño")
ob <- d$outbreaks |>
  mutate(enso_state  = factor(enso_state, levels = ENSO_STATES),
         region      = factor(region, levels = LV$region),
         admin_level = factor(admin_level),
         pop         = pop / 1e3) |>   # thousands
  relab("region")
GT_VARS <- c("cases", "duration_weeks", "duration_months", "attack_rate_1k", "pop")
GT_LAB  <- list(cases = "Suspected cases", duration_weeks = "Duration (weeks)",
                duration_months = "Duration (months, monthly track)",
                attack_rate_1k = "Attack rate (/1,000)", pop = "Population (thousands)",
                admin_level = "Admin level",
                region = if (identical(GROUP_LABEL_MODE, "lag")) "ENSO lag class" else "ENSO group")
GT_DIG  <- list(cases = 0, duration_weeks = 1, duration_months = 0, attack_rate_1k = 2, pop = 0)
GT_STAT <- list(gtsummary::all_continuous() ~ "{median} [{p25}–{p75}]",
                gtsummary::all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)")
gt_sum <- function(x, by, include)
  gtsummary::tbl_summary(x, by = all_of(by), include = all_of(include),
                         label = GT_LAB[intersect(names(GT_LAB), include)],
                         digits = GT_DIG[intersect(names(GT_DIG), include)],
                         statistic = GT_STAT, missing = "no")
gt_p <- function(t)
  gtsummary::add_p(t, test = list(gtsummary::all_continuous() ~ "kruskal.test",
                                  gtsummary::all_categorical() ~ "chisq.test")) |>
  gtsummary::bold_p(t = 0.05)

if (HAS_GT) {
  emit_gt(gt_sum(ob, "admin_level", c(GT_VARS, "region")) |> gtsummary::add_overall(),
          "Analysis dataset: outbreak descriptors by admin level", slug = "outbreaks_analysis_by_level")
} else cat("*gtsummary is not installed: the analysis-dataset and ENSO-condition summaries are skipped.*\n\n")
```

**By ENSO condition.** Each outbreak takes the ENSO state of its cholera
season-year: the ONI of the DJF whose December lies in that season-year,
El Niño at ≥ +0.5 and La Niña at ≤ −0.5 (`r if (is.null(d$enso_state_rule)) "threshold phase of the DJF ONI, no persistence" else d$enso_state_rule$label`; not the CPC episode rule). Differences are tested with
Kruskal–Wallis (continuous) and χ² (categorical) tests; p < 0.05 in bold. These
are observed differences, not adjusted for location, season or year (the
models of Section 2 are).

```{r}
#| label: r1-enso
#| results: asis
#| eval: !expr HAS_GT
t_enso <- gt_sum(ob, "enso_state", c(GT_VARS, "admin_level", "region")) |>
  gtsummary::add_overall() |> gt_p()
sig <- t_enso$table_body |> filter(row_type == "label", !is.na(p.value), p.value < 0.05)
cat(if (nrow(sig))
      paste0("Outbreak characteristics that differ between ENSO states (p < 0.05): ",
             paste(sprintf("%s (%s)", bold(sig$label),
                         ifelse(sig$p.value < 1e-3, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %s", signif(sig$p.value, 2)))),
                   collapse = "; "), ".\n\n")
    else "No outbreak characteristic differs between ENSO states at p < 0.05.\n\n")
emit_gt(t_enso, "Analysis dataset: outbreak descriptors by season-year ENSO state",
        slug = "outbreaks_by_enso")
emit_gt(gtsummary::tbl_strata(ob, strata = admin_level,
          .tbl_fun = ~ gt_sum(.x, "enso_state", c(GT_VARS, "region")) |> gt_p()),
        "Analysis dataset: outbreak descriptors by season-year ENSO state, within admin level",
        slug = "outbreaks_by_enso_level")
```

# 2 — ENSO effects

```{r}
#| label: r2-load
EFF <- setNames(lapply(FIG1_TRACKS, function(t) R_("results_report_effects", track = t)), FIG1_TRACKS)
TRACK_FCT <- function(x) factor(x, levels = FIG1_TRACKS)
eff_long <- function(el) bind_rows(lapply(FIG1_TRACKS, function(t) mutate(EFF[[t]][[el]], track = t)))
```

Effects are the posterior median incidence-rate ratio (IRR) at each ONI
condition of Figure 2 vs. neutral (ONI 0), with its 95% CrI; bold = CrI
excludes 1. Estimands per track:
`r paste(sprintf("**%s**: %s", FIG1_TRACKS, vapply(EFF, function(e) e$estimand, "")), collapse = "; ")`.
For duration, a hazard ratio < 1 means longer outbreaks.

```{r}
#| label: r2
#| results: asis
emit(eff_long("best_lag") |>
       mutate(val = sprintf("%+d", as.integer(best_lag)), track = TRACK_FCT(track)) |>
       report_wide("region", "track", "val", levels = list(region = LV$region),
                   rename = c(`ENSO group` = "region")) |>
       with_pmax("ENSO group", "group"),
     "Deployed ENSO lag by ENSO group and track (months; negative = ENSO leads the outcome; selected by LOO, no interval — Δelpd in the supplementary lag tables)",
     slug = "enso_lags")

emit(eff_long("effects_region") |>
       mutate(track = TRACK_FCT(track), enso_label = cond_fct(enso_label),
              val = fmt_irr(IRR, IRR_lo, IRR_hi)) |>
       report_wide(c("track", "region"), "enso_label", "val", levels = list(region = LV$region),
                   rename = c(Track = "track", `ENSO group` = "region")) |>
       with_pmax("ENSO group", "group"),
     "Exposure-response by ENSO group and track at the Figure 2 ONI conditions (IRR vs neutral, posterior median, 95% CrI; conditional on the other model terms; for occurrence, a direct effect given outbreak history and contagion)",
     pack_by = "Track", slug = "enso_erf_group", raw = eff_long("effects_region"))

# Largest / smallest country effect per group: highest / lowest median IRR on
# the adverse scale (duration: the lowest cessation hazard ratio is the largest).
ext <- eff_long("effects_country") |>
  mutate(adv = TRACK_ADVERSE_SIGN[track] * log(IRR),
         cell = if (is.null(MB)) sprintf("%s %s", country, fmt_irr(IRR, IRR_lo, IRR_hi))
                else sprintf("%s [p_max %s] %s", country, pmax_lab(country), fmt_irr(IRR, IRR_lo, IRR_hi))) |>
  group_by(track, region, enso_label) |>
  summarise(largest = cell[which.max(adv)], smallest = cell[which.min(adv)], .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_longer(c(largest, smallest), names_to = "which", values_to = "val") |>
  mutate(track = TRACK_FCT(track), enso_label = cond_fct(enso_label))
emit(ext |> report_wide(c("track", "region", "which"), "enso_label", "val",
                        levels = list(region = LV$region),
                        rename = c(Track = "track", `ENSO group` = "region", Country = "which")),
     "Largest and smallest country effect within each ENSO group (country: IRR vs neutral, posterior median, 95% CrI; adverse scale, so for duration 'largest' = lowest hazard ratio)",
     pack_by = "Track", slug = "enso_erf_country_extremes")
```

# 3 — ENSO-sensitive areas

```{r}
#| label: r3-load
ex <- R_("results_report_enso_exposure")
HL <- RES$style$enso_headline
TRACK_KEYS <- c(ex$tracks, "any", "any_credible", "concordant2")
if (is.null(HL) || !isTRUE(HL$direction %in% unique(ex$exposure$direction)) ||
    !isTRUE(HL$track %in% TRACK_KEYS) || !.has(ex$magnitudes, HL$magnitude) || !.has(ex$cutoffs, HL$cutoff))
  stop("results.style.enso_headline must name a cell of report_enso_exposure: direction in {",
       paste(unique(ex$exposure$direction), collapse = ", "), "}, track in {",
       paste(TRACK_KEYS, collapse = ", "), "}, magnitude in {", paste(ex$magnitudes, collapse = ", "),
       "} (thresholds.enso_magnitudes), cutoff in {", paste(ex$cutoffs, collapse = ", "),
       "} (thresholds.pop_prob_cutoffs).", call. = FALSE)
HL_M <- ex$magnitudes[which.min(abs(ex$magnitudes - HL$magnitude))]
HL_P <- ex$cutoffs[which.min(abs(ex$cutoffs - HL$cutoff))]
TRACK_LAB <- c(stats::setNames(ex$tracks, ex$tracks), any = "any track (union)",
               any_credible = "some single track", concordant2 = "≥2 tracks")
DIR_LAB   <- c(adverse = "adverse", protective = "protective", either = "either direction")
MAG_LEVELS <- fmt_pct(ex$magnitudes)
lab <- function(d) d |> mutate(enso_label = cond_fct(enso_label),
                               mag = factor(fmt_pct(magnitude), levels = MAG_LEVELS),
                               trk = factor(TRACK_LAB[track], levels = TRACK_LAB[TRACK_KEYS]),
                               dir = factor(DIR_LAB[direction], levels = DIR_LAB))
e5 <- lab(ex$exposure)
g5 <- lab(ex$grid) |> mutate(pcut = factor(fmt_pct(cutoff), levels = fmt_pct(ex$cutoffs)))
at_mag <- function(d, m) filter(d, abs(magnitude - m) < 1e-9)
at_cut <- function(d, cut) filter(d, abs(cutoff - cut) < 1e-9)
hl_grid <- at_mag(filter(g5, direction == HL$direction, track == HL$track), HL_M)
# CSVs carry the artefact's own columns, not the display factors added by lab().
unlab <- function(d) select(d, -any_of(c("mag", "trk", "dir", "pcut")))
# The certainty rule as a phrase, for a direction and a cutoff text `pt`.
rule_txt <- function(dir, pt, m = HL_M, track = HL$track) {
  eff <- sprintf("%s effect beyond %s", DIR_LAB[[dir]], fmt_pct(m))
  if (track == "any_credible") sprintf("P(%s) ≥ %s on at least one track on its own", eff, pt)
  else sprintf("P(%s, %s) ≥ %s", eff, TRACK_LAB[[track]], pt)
}
hl_rule <- function(pt) rule_txt(HL$direction, pt)
cert_cell <- function(n, pop, pct) sprintf("%s ADM1 · %s (%s)", fmt_int(n), fmt_pop(pop, 1), fmt_pct(pct, 1))
```

An ADM1's ENSO effect on a track is **adverse** when it means more cholera
(higher onset or case rate; for duration a *lower* cessation hazard, i.e.
longer outbreaks) and **protective** otherwise. For a magnitude m, an ADM1 is
exposed on a posterior draw when its drawn IRR lies beyond 1 + m in that
direction. Across the `r paste(ex$tracks, collapse = ", ")` tracks, "some
single track" counts an ADM1 when at least one track **on its own** meets the
certainty cutoff; "any track (union)" takes the certainty of the union (it
inflates with several weak tracks: three tracks at 0.65 give 0.96); "≥2 tracks"
needs two tracks on the same draw. Population: observed sub-unit population in
`r ex$pop_ref_year`; `r ex$n_draws` posterior draws.

Two readings of the same draws:

- **ENSO-sensitive ADM1 units** (the headline): ADM1s with posterior
  probability ≥ p of the effect. A classification of the posterior, so it has
  **no interval by construction**; its sensitivity to m, p and the cross-track
  rule is shown instead.
- **Expected exposed population**: on each draw, the population of the ADM1s
  exposed on that draw; mean + **95% CrI** across draws (per track).

**Headline definition** (`results.style.enso_headline`): an ADM1 is
ENSO-sensitive when **`r hl_rule(fmt_pct(HL_P))`**.

```{r}
#| label: r3-fun
# One block per direction: Africa bullets, the headline table by region, the
# expected exposed population per track, and the alternative definitions.
# (`dr`, not `dir`: lab() adds a `dir` column that would mask the argument.)
exposure_block <- function(dr, tag) {
  hg <- at_cut(at_mag(filter(g5, direction == dr, track == HL$track), HL_M), HL_P)
  afr <- filter(hg, level == "continent") |> arrange(enso_label)
  cat(paste0("- ", bold(as.character(afr$enso_label)), ": ", bold(fmt_int(afr$n_adm1)),
             " ADM1 units, ", bold(fmt_pop(afr$pop, 1)), " people (", bold(fmt_pct(afr$pct, 1)),
             " of the covered population)", collapse = "\n"), "\n\n")

  emit(hg |> filter(level != "country") |>
         mutate(val = cert_cell(n_adm1, pop, pct)) |>
         report_wide("scope", "enso_label", "val", levels = list(scope = LV$scope),
                     rename = c(Scope = "scope")),
       sprintf("ENSO-sensitive ADM1 units (%s): %s — Africa + by ENSO group (N ADM1 · population (share of the scope's population); no interval by construction)",
               DIR_LAB[[dr]], rule_txt(dr, fmt_pct(HL_P))),
       slug = paste0("enso_sensitive_", tag), raw = unlab(filter(hg, level != "country")))

  emit(at_mag(filter(e5, direction == dr, track %in% ex$tracks, level != "country"), HL_M) |>
         mutate(val = sprintf("%s · %s", fmt_pop_ci(pop_mean, pop_lo, pop_hi, 1),
                              fmt_pct_ci(pct_mean, pct_lo, pct_hi, 0))) |>
         report_wide(c("scope", "trk"), "enso_label", "val", levels = list(scope = LV$scope),
                     rename = c(Scope = "scope", Track = "trk")),
       sprintf("Expected exposed population (%s effect beyond %s on the track), per posterior draw — Africa + by ENSO group (population · share; mean, 95%% CrI)",
               DIR_LAB[[dr]], fmt_pct(HL_M)),
       pack_by = "Scope", slug = paste0("enso_expected_", tag),
       raw = unlab(at_mag(filter(e5, direction == dr, level != "country"), HL_M)))

  ga <- filter(g5, direction == dr, level == "continent")
  alt <- bind_rows(
    at_cut(at_mag(ga, HL_M), HL_P) |>
      mutate(varied = "Cross-track rule", def = as.character(trk)),
    at_cut(filter(ga, track == HL$track), HL_P) |>
      mutate(varied = "Magnitude m", def = paste0("m = ", fmt_pct(magnitude))),
    at_mag(filter(ga, track == HL$track), HL_M) |>
      mutate(varied = "Probability cutoff p", def = paste0("p = ", fmt_pct(cutoff)))) |>
    mutate(def = ifelse((varied == "Cross-track rule" & track == HL$track) |
                          (varied == "Magnitude m" & abs(magnitude - HL_M) < 1e-9) |
                          (varied == "Probability cutoff p" & abs(cutoff - HL_P) < 1e-9),
                        paste(def, "(headline)"), def),
           varied = factor(varied, levels = c("Cross-track rule", "Magnitude m", "Probability cutoff p")),
           def = factor(def, levels = unique(def)),
           val = cert_cell(n_adm1, pop, pct))
  emit(alt |> report_wide(c("varied", "def"), "enso_label", "val",
                          rename = c(Varied = "varied", Definition = "def")),
       sprintf("ENSO-sensitive ADM1 units (%s), alternative definitions — Africa; one element of the headline definition varied at a time (N ADM1 · population (share); no interval by construction)",
               DIR_LAB[[dr]]),
       pack_by = "Varied", slug = paste0("enso_sensitive_alt_", tag), raw = unlab(alt))
}
```

## Adverse effects (more cholera)

```{r}
#| label: r3-adverse
#| results: asis
exposure_block("adverse", "adverse")
```

## Protective effects (less cholera)

# 4 — Historical smoothing and attribution of past ENSO events

```{r}
#| label: r4-load
EV_ON <- nzchar(RES$event_manifest %||% "")
# The headlined forecast-attribution cell (results.style.attrib_headline.window;
# 09's attrib_cells()): "attribution" = each group over its own firm window,
# "attribution_common" = every group over the common Africa window
# (results.scope.africa). Every forecast-attribution headline filters on it.
HL_WIN <- as.character(RES$style$attrib_headline[["window"]] %||% "attribution")
WIN_LAB <- c(attribution = "each group to its firm horizon",
             post_fork = "each group to its firm horizon, post-fork months only",
             attribution_common = "common Africa window",
             post_fork_common = "common Africa window, post-fork months only",
             attribution_firm = "common window, each group cut at its firm horizon (no continuation)")
# The headlined explosive mode (results.style.attrib_headline.explosive):
# "drop" = pairs reaching thresholds.explosive_case_cap in either arm
# dropped (explosive_guard TRUE), "none" = every pair kept (FALSE).
HL_EXPLOSIVE <- as.character(RES$style$attrib_headline[["explosive"]] %||% "drop")
if (!HL_EXPLOSIVE %in% as.character(unlist(RES$derivation$explosive_modes)))
  stop("results.style.attrib_headline$explosive must be one of results.derivation.explosive_modes {",
       paste(unlist(RES$derivation$explosive_modes), collapse = ", "), "}.", call. = FALSE)
HL_GUARD <- identical(HL_EXPLOSIVE, "drop")
EXPL_CAP <- as.numeric(RES$thresholds$explosive_case_cap)
EXPL_LAB <- if (HL_GUARD)
  sprintf("explosive replicates (group window cases ≥ %s in either arm) dropped",
          format(EXPL_CAP, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)) else "every replicate kept (no explosive guard)"
INT_LAB <-if (AF_POST) "95% posterior interval (uncertainty of the ENSO effect)" else
           "95% paired-bootstrap interval (Monte-Carlo precision)"
# Attributable fraction / number per (cell, scope, metric) in one shape:
# af, af_lo, af_hi, an, an_lo, an_hi. Posterior: the adjusted posterior median
# and interval (as Figures 3 and 4); bootstrap: the replicate means. A scope
# whose posterior spread is unidentified (noise share >=
# results.thresholds.af_noise_share_max) prints its pooled value with no
# interval; af_unidentified_txt() lists those scopes.
af_rows <- function(d, post) if (post) {
  ni  <- if ("af_identified" %in% names(d)) d$af_identified %in% FALSE else rep(FALSE, nrow(d))
  nin <- if ("an_identified" %in% names(d)) d$an_identified %in% FALSE else rep(FALSE, nrow(d))
  mutate(d, af = ifelse(ni, af_pool, af_adj_med), af_lo = af_adj_lo, af_hi = af_adj_hi,
         an = ifelse(nin, an_pool, an_adj_med), an_lo = an_adj_lo, an_hi = an_adj_hi)
} else mutate(d, af = af_of_means, an = an_mean)
#' One sentence naming the non-country scopes of a posterior table whose AF
#' spread is unidentified, and how many country rows are; "" when none.
af_unidentified_txt <- function(d, what) {
  if (!"af_identified" %in% names(d)) return("")
  ni <- filter(d, af_identified %in% FALSE)
  if (!nrow(ni)) return("")
  nc <- filter(ni, level != "country")
  where <- c(if (nrow(nc)) paste(unique(sprintf("%s (%s)", nc$scope, nc$metric)), collapse = ", "),
             if (any(ni$level == "country"))
               sprintf("%d of %d country rows", sum(ni$level == "country"), sum(d$level == "country")))
  sprintf(paste0("%s: posterior spread not identified (Monte-Carlo noise share ≥ %s; pooled value shown, ",
                 "no interval) for %s%s. "),
          what, fmt_num(RES$thresholds$af_noise_share_max %||% 0.8, 2), paste(where, collapse = " and "),
          if (!nrow(nc)) "; every Africa and ENSO-group scope is identified" else "")
}
af_wide <- function(d, rows, rename)
  d |> mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = c("cases", "onsets")),
              AF = fmt_af(af, af_lo, af_hi), AN = fmt_an(as.character(metric), an, an_lo, an_hi)) |>
    select(all_of(rows), metric, AF, AN) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = metric, values_from = c(AF, AN), names_glue = "{metric}: {.value}") |>
    select(all_of(rows), starts_with("cases"), starts_with("onsets")) |>
    rename(all_of(rename))
```

```{r}
#| label: r5-load
f  <- R_("results_report_forecast", sets = SETS)

HLA <- RES$style$attrib_headline

       call. = FALSE)
fc_af <- if (AF_POST) {

} else {

}
# Scope-level IPCC class of Figure 4a (report_attrib_metrics v2 ipcc_scope), at
# the headline magnitude.
ipcc5 <- R_("results_report_attrib_metrics", sets = SETS)$ipcc_scope
fc_af <- mutate(fc_af, Scope = scope_fct(scope_lab(level, region)))
if (!is.null(ipcc5))
  fc_af <- left_join(fc_af, ipcc5 |>
                       filter(window == HL_WIN, explosive_guard == HL_GUARD, analog_set == MAIN_SET,
                              level != "country", abs(magnitude - HLA_M) < 1e-9) |>
                       select(level, scope, metric, ipcc_class = class),
                     by = c("level", "scope", "metric"))
inv_af <- function(af) ifelse(af < 1, 1 / (1 - af), Inf)
ax5 <- ae$exposure |>
  filter(window == HL_WIN, explosive_guard == HL_GUARD, analog_set == MAIN_SET, level != "country") |>
  mutate(Scope = scope_fct(as.character(scope)), mag = factor(fmt_pct(magnitude), levels = fmt_pct(ae$magnitudes)),
         metric = factor(metric, levels = c("cases", "onsets")))
BOOT_ON <- isTRUE(ae$n_boot > 0)
# Childs population interval: the posterior one when results.af_posterior
# (attrib_exposure_posterior, variant adj: the Childs rule per posterior draw on
# the noise-adjusted ADM1 AF), else the paired bootstrap's (none when
# attrib_boot_b = 0). The point stays report_attrib_exposure's.
# The posterior adj variant covers the ADM1s whose
# posterior spread is identified; its point replaces the all-ADM1 point so the
# point and interval describe the same ADM1s, and the unidentified ADM1s are
# reported apart (unid_*: their population; unid_pass_pop: those whose pooled
# estimate passes the rule). The reported value is the
# posterior mean over draws (pop_mean / pct_mean / n_adm1_mean) with its 95%
# CrI, as the main text and table S11; the posterior point (rule on the
# posterior point AF) and adj + unid_pass = the all-ADM1 Childs point stay in
# the artefact.
if (AF_POST) {
  axp <- R_("results_attrib_exposure_posterior", sets = SETS)$exposure |>
    filter(window == HL_WIN, explosive_guard == HL_GUARD, analog_set == MAIN_SET, level != "country") |>
    mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = c("cases", "onsets")), scope = as.character(scope), class = "childs")
  vv <- function(v, ...) filter(axp, variant == v) |> select(metric, magnitude, level, scope, class, ...)
  ax5 <- ax5 |>
    left_join(vv("adj", post_pop = pop_mean, post_pct = pct_mean, post_n = n_adm1_mean,
                 post_lo = pop_lo, post_hi = pop_hi, post_pct_lo = pct_lo, post_pct_hi = pct_hi),
              by = c("metric", "magnitude", "level", "scope", "class")) |>
    mutate(pop = ifelse(class == "childs" & !is.na(post_pop), post_pop, pop),
           pct = ifelse(class == "childs" & !is.na(post_pct), post_pct, pct),
           n_adm1 = ifelse(class == "childs" & !is.na(post_n), post_n, n_adm1),
           pop_lo = ifelse(class == "childs", post_lo, pop_lo), pop_hi = ifelse(class == "childs", post_hi, pop_hi),
           pct_lo = ifelse(class == "childs", post_pct_lo, pct_lo),
           pct_hi = ifelse(class == "childs", post_pct_hi, pct_hi)) |>
    select(-starts_with("post_"))
  if (any(axp$variant == "unidentified"))
    ax5 <- ax5 |>
      left_join(vv("unidentified", unid_pop = pop_point, unid_n = n_adm1_point),
                by = c("metric", "magnitude", "level", "scope", "class")) |>
      left_join(vv("unidentified_pass", unid_pass_pop = pop_point, unid_pass_n = n_adm1_point),
                by = c("metric", "magnitude", "level", "scope", "class"))
}
#' The sentence on the unidentified ADM1s of one Childs row, "" when none.
childs_unid_txt <- function(r) {
  if (!nrow(r) || !"unid_n" %in% names(r) || is.na(r$unid_n[1]) || r$unid_n[1] == 0) return("")
  sprintf(paste0(" A further %s people live in %s ADM1s whose posterior spread is not identified (Monte-Carlo ",
                 "noise share ≥ %s); on their pooled estimate %s people in %s of them pass the rule."),
          fmt_pop(r$unid_pop[1], 1), fmt_int(r$unid_n[1]), fmt_num(RES$thresholds$af_noise_share_max %||% 0.8, 2),
          fmt_pop(r$unid_pass_pop[1], 1), fmt_int(r$unid_pass_n[1]))
}
CHILDS_INT <- if (AF_POST) "95% posterior interval" else if (BOOT_ON) "95% paired-bootstrap interval" else NA
ft <- f$horizon_totals |> filter(run == "forecast", level != "country") |>
  mutate(Scope = scope_fct(as.character(scope)))
ft_af <- filter(ft, Scope == "Africa")
q_ <- function(d, q) filter(d, quantity == q)
# Which factual the attribution metrics use (09: results.inputs.attrib_manifest):
# "attrib" = the factual launched at the counterfactual handoff, the displayed
# forecast (totals) staying the factual launched at the latest data month.
ATTRIB_F <- identical(f$attrib_factual %||% "forecast", "attrib")
FAC_LAUNCH <- as.Date(f$arm_starts$factual %||% NA)
ATT_LAUNCH <- as.Date(f$attrib_arm_starts$factual %||% NA)
# The Africa of the attribution (09: results.scope.africa) and
# Data S1, D23 (attribution$africa_scope): which groups are read past their firm
# horizon on the analog ENSO continuation, how far, and which counterfactual
# winters the window reads.
AW <- f$africa_window
AW_COMMON <- identical(AW$mode, "common")
a28 <- R_("results_attribution", sets = SETS)$africa_scope
GRP_LAB5 <- function(g) unname(ifelse(is.na(GROUP_SHORT[g]), g, GROUP_SHORT[g]))
cont5 <- if (AW_COMMON) filter(a28, months_past_firm > 0) else a28[0, ]
cut5  <- if (AW_COMMON) filter(a28, firm_horizon > group_end) else a28[0, ]
unc5  <- filter(a28, nzchar(cf_winters_unconstrained))
AFRICA_TXT <- if (AW_COMMON) paste0(
  sprintf("Africa is every included ENSO group over one calendar window, **%s** (%d months, %d groups). ",
          AW$label, AW$n_months, length(AW$groups)),
  if (nrow(cont5)) sprintf("Groups whose firm horizon ends earlier are read on into the simulated analog continuation of ENSO: %s. ",
    paste(sprintf("%s from %s (longest continuation lead %d months, analog CRPSS vs climatology %s)",
                  GRP_LAB5(cont5$enso_group), format(cont5$firm_horizon + 31, "%b %Y"), cont5$lead_max,
                  ifelse(is.na(cont5$crpss_at_lead_max), "n/a", fmt_num(cont5$crpss_at_lead_max, 2))),
          collapse = "; ")) else "",
  if (nrow(cut5)) sprintf("Groups forecast further (%s) are cut at %s. ", paste(GRP_LAB5(cut5$enso_group), collapse = ", "),
                         format(AW$end, "%b %Y")) else "",
  if (length(AW$censored)) sprintf("Groups ending before the window end (continuation capped): %s. ",
                                   paste(GRP_LAB5(AW$censored), collapse = ", ")) else "",
  "The forecast totals of each group cover its own forecast window; the attribution metrics (ratio of means, AF, AN, ",
  "populations) and every Africa row cover the Africa window, Africa summing the groups (Data S1, D23). ",
  "Sensitivities: each group cut at its firm horizon (no continuation) and the former mixed windows.") else sprintf(paste0("Two windows: the **forecast totals** (cases, onsets, incidence) cover each group's forecast window, ",
                      "and Africa the window all groups share (%s months), so the Africa total is not the sum of the ",
                      "groups; the **attribution metrics** (ratio of means, AF, AN, populations) cover the attribution ",
                      "window from %s to each group's firm horizon, Africa summing the groups."),
               fmt_int(f$n_months$n_months_window[f$n_months$level == "continent"]), format(ae$attrib_start, "%B %Y"))
# The counterfactual constrains only the winter its analogs are classified on;
# a later winter read by a group's window compares the factual's continuation
# with an unconstrained counterfactual winter.
CAVEAT_TXT <- if (nrow(unc5)) sprintf(paste0(
  "Caveat: the counterfactual analogs are selected on DJF %s only, but %s read%s the ONI of DJF %s through %s ",
  "deployed lead%s, a winter the counterfactual does not constrain (D23)."),
  unc5$cf_winter_constrained[1] %||% "n/a", paste(GRP_LAB5(unc5$enso_group), collapse = ", "),
  if (nrow(unc5) == 1L) "s" else "", paste(unique(unc5$cf_winters_unconstrained), collapse = ", "),
  if (nrow(unc5) == 1L) "its" else "their", if (nrow(unc5) == 1L) "s" else "s") else ""
```

Forecast = the factual simulation with the calibrated CFSv2 ENSO forecast;
counterfactual = the same replicates (same smoothing handoff state and
posterior draw) with ENSO analogs of set **`r MAIN_SET`**. Each ENSO group is
forecast to its own firm horizon (the last month its deployed ENSO lags read the
firm ENSO forecast). `r AFRICA_TXT`
`r CAVEAT_TXT`
Forecast totals: median + 95% across replicates. Ratio of means,
AF and AN: `r INT_LAB`. Headline attribution cell: **`r if (HL_WIN %in% names(WIN_LAB)) WIN_LAB[[HL_WIN]] else HL_WIN`**.
`r if (AF_POST) af_unidentified_txt(filter(R_("results_af_posterior", sets = SETS)$scope, cell == HL_WIN, analog_set == MAIN_SET, explosive_guard == HL_GUARD), "Forecast attribution") else ""`
`r if (ATTRIB_F) sprintf("The attribution metrics compare the counterfactual with a factual launched at the counterfactual handoff (**%s**), from the same smoothing state, seed and posterior draw of every replicate; the forecast totals are the factual launched at the latest data month (**%s**), its earlier months taken from the data-conditioned smoothing. Their difference is the information component (supplementary tables).", format(ATT_LAUNCH, "%B %Y"), format(FAC_LAUNCH, "%B %Y")) else if (!is.na(FAC_LAUNCH) && FAC_LAUNCH > ae$attrib_start) sprintf("The factual series is the data-conditioned smoothing up to its launch (**%s**), a free simulation after.", format(FAC_LAUNCH, "%B %Y")) else ""`

- **Africa**: **`r fmt_ci_cases(q_(ft_af, "tot_cases")$med, q_(ft_af, "tot_cases")$lo, q_(ft_af, "tot_cases")$hi)`**
  forecast cases and **`r fmt_ci_int(q_(ft_af, "tot_onsets")$med, q_(ft_af, "tot_onsets")$lo, q_(ft_af, "tot_onsets")$hi)`**
  outbreak onsets over the forecast window; annualised incidence
  **`r fmt_rate(q_(ft_af, "inc_ann_100k")$med, q_(ft_af, "inc_ann_100k")$lo, q_(ft_af, "inc_ann_100k")$hi)`**
  per 100,000 person-years.
- **ENSO-attributable**: ratio of means (forecast ÷ counterfactual) of cases
  **`r with(filter(fc_af, Scope == "Africa", metric == "cases"), fmt_ci(inv_af(af), inv_af(af_lo), inv_af(af_hi), 2))`**,
  AF **`r with(filter(fc_af, Scope == "Africa", metric == "cases"), fmt_pct_ci(af, af_lo, af_hi))`**
  (**`r with(filter(fc_af, Scope == "Africa", metric == "cases"), fmt_ci_cases(an, an_lo, an_hi))`** cases);
  onsets AF **`r with(filter(fc_af, Scope == "Africa", metric == "onsets"), fmt_pct_ci(af, af_lo, af_hi))`**.
- **Robust increase** (IPCC AR6, m = `r fmt_pct(HLA_M)`): **`r with(filter(ax5, Scope == "Africa", metric == "cases", class == "robust", abs(magnitude - HLA_M) < 1e-9), sprintf("%s (%s, %s ADM1)", fmt_pop(pop, 1), fmt_pct(pct, 1), fmt_int(n_adm1)))`**
  people live in ADM1s with a robust ENSO-driven increase in cases (no
  interval by construction).
- **Childs** (mean forecast ≥ `r fmt_num(1 + HLA_M, 2)` × mean
  counterfactual): **`r with(filter(ax5, Scope == "Africa", metric == "cases", class == "childs", abs(magnitude - HLA_M) < 1e-9), if (!is.na(CHILDS_INT)) sprintf("%s (%s, %s ADM1)", fmt_pop_ci(pop, pop_lo, pop_hi, 1), fmt_pct_ci(pct, pct_lo, pct_hi), fmt_int(n_adm1)) else sprintf("%s (%s, %s ADM1)", fmt_pop(pop, 1), fmt_pct(pct, 1), fmt_int(n_adm1)))`**
  people`r if (is.na(CHILDS_INT)) " (no interval: the paired bootstrap is off, results.derivation.attrib_boot_b = 0, and results.af_posterior is false)" else paste0(" (", CHILDS_INT, if (AF_POST) "; the Childs rule applied per posterior draw to each ADM1's noise-adjusted attributable fraction, over the ADM1s whose posterior spread is identified" else "", ")")`.`r childs_unid_txt(filter(ax5, Scope == "Africa", metric == "cases", class == "childs", abs(magnitude - HLA_M) < 1e-9))`

```{r}
#| label: r5
#| results: asis
emit(ft |> filter(quantity %in% c("tot_cases", "tot_onsets", "inc_ann_100k")) |>
       mutate(val = fmt_by_quantity(quantity, med, lo, hi),
              Quantity = factor(QUANTITY_LABELS[quantity], levels = QUANTITY_LABELS)) |>
       report_wide("Scope", "Quantity", "val") |>
       left_join(f$scope_pop |> filter(level != "country") |>
                   left_join(select(f$n_months, level, scope, n_months_window), by = c("level", "scope")) |>
                   transmute(Scope = scope_fct(as.character(scope)), `Window (months)` = fmt_int(n_months_window),
                             Population = fmt_pop(pop, 1)), by = "Scope") |>
       arrange(Scope) |> relocate(`Window (months)`, Population, .after = Scope),
     "Forecast cumulative cases, outbreak onsets and annualised incidence (/100,000 person-years) over each scope's forecast window — Africa + by ENSO group (median, 95% across replicates)",
     slug = "forecast_totals", raw = ft)

emit(fc_af |> arrange(Scope) |>
       mutate(val = paste0(fmt_ratio_bold(inv_af(af), inv_af(af_lo), inv_af(af_hi), 2),
                           if ("ipcc_class" %in% names(fc_af)) paste0(" · ", ipcc_class) else ""),
              metric = factor(metric, levels = c("cases", "onsets"))) |>
       report_wide("Scope", "metric", "val", rename = c(Cases = "cases", Onsets = "onsets")),
     sprintf("Ratio of means, forecast ÷ counterfactual (%s), over the attribution window (Figure 4a) — Africa + by ENSO group (%s; bold = interval excludes 1%s)",
             MAIN_SET, INT_LAB, if ("ipcc_class" %in% names(fc_af))
               sprintf("; · IPCC AR6 class of the scope's paired totals at m = %s", fmt_pct(HLA_M)) else ""),
     slug = "forecast_ratio_of_means", raw = fc_af)

emit(fc_af |> arrange(Scope) |> af_wide("Scope", character(0)),
     sprintf("ENSO-attributable fraction (AF) and number (AN) of forecast cases and outbreak onsets (counterfactual %s) — Africa + by ENSO group (%s; bold = interval excludes 0)",
             MAIN_SET, INT_LAB),
     slug = "forecast_af")

CLS5 <- c(robust = "IPCC robust increase", conflicting = "IPCC conflicting",
          childs = "Childs (ratio of means ≥ 1 + m)", childs_median = "Childs, ratio of medians")
pop_cell <- function(cls, pop, lo, hi, pct, n) ifelse(
  cls %in% c("childs", "childs_median") & !is.na(lo),
  sprintf("%s · %s [%s ADM1]", fmt_pop_ci(pop, lo, hi, 1), fmt_pct(pct, 1), fmt_int(n)),
  sprintf("%s · %s [%s ADM1]", fmt_pop(pop, 1), fmt_pct(pct, 1), fmt_int(n)))
for (cl in list(c("robust", "conflicting"), c("childs", "childs_median"))) {
  emit(ax5 |> filter(class %in% cl) |>
         mutate(cls = factor(CLS5[class], levels = CLS5), val = pop_cell(class, pop, pop_lo, pop_hi, pct, n_adm1),
                mag = paste0("m = ", mag, ifelse(abs(magnitude - HLA_M) < 1e-9, " (headline)", "")),
                mag = factor(mag, levels = unique(mag[order(magnitude)]))) |>
         arrange(metric, cls, Scope) |>
         mutate(blk = paste(metric, "·", cls), blk = factor(blk, levels = unique(blk))) |>
         report_wide(c("blk", "Scope"), "mag", "val"),
       if ("robust" %in% cl)
         sprintf("Population in ADM1s with a robust ENSO-driven increase (IPCC AR6 Atlas: ≥ %s of paired replicates with forecast > (1 + m) × counterfactual and ≥ %s with forecast > counterfactual; conflicting = only the first) — Africa + by ENSO group, each magnitude m (population · share [N ADM1]; no interval by construction)",
                 fmt_pct(ae$robust_exceed), fmt_pct(ae$robust_agree))
       else sprintf("Childs-type population: ADM1s whose forecast is at least (1 + m) × the counterfactual (%s) — Africa + by ENSO group, each m (population · share [N ADM1]; %s)",
                    MAIN_SET, if (is.na(CHILDS_INT)) "no interval: the paired bootstrap is off, attrib_boot_b = 0"
                              else if (AF_POST && !BOOT_ON) paste0("ratio of means with its ", CHILDS_INT,
                                                                   "; ratio of medians: no interval")
                              else paste("population with its", CHILDS_INT)),
       pack_by = "blk", slug = paste0("forecast_pop_", cl[[1]]),
       raw = filter(ae$exposure, class %in% cl))
}
```

## ENSO effect sizes by country (BRMS)

IRR = posterior median (exp of the median log IRR) + 95% CrI at each ONI
condition vs. neutral; for the **duration** track the cessation hazard ratio
(higher ⇒ outbreaks end sooner), with the restricted-mean-duration (RMD) ratio
as the "last N× longer" estimand.

```{r}
#| label: s-effects
#| results: asis
for (trk in FIG1_TRACKS) {
  e <- EFF[[trk]]
  cat(sprintf("\n\n### %s\n\n*Estimand: %s.*\n\n", trk, e$estimand))
  emit(report_wide(mutate(e$effects_country, enso_label = cond_fct(enso_label),
                          val = fmt_ratio_bold(IRR, IRR_lo, IRR_hi)),
                   c("region", "country"), "enso_label", "val", levels = list(region = LV$region),
                   rename = c(Region = "region", Country = "country")) |>
         with_afro("Country") |> with_pmax("Country"),
       sprintf("%s — IRR (posterior median, 95%% CrI) at each ENSO condition, by country (bold = CrI excludes 1)", trk),
       pack_by = "Region")

  prep <- function(d) mutate(d, region = factor(region, levels = LV$region), enso_label = cond_fct(enso_label))

  if (!is.null(e$rmd_ratio) && nrow(e$rmd_ratio))
    emit(prep(e$rmd_ratio) |>
           arrange(region, enso_label) |>
           transmute(
             Region = region, Condition = enso_label,
             `RMD ratio (med, 95% CrI)` = fmt_ratio_bold(ratio_med, ratio_lo, ratio_hi),
             `RMD high (mo)` = fmt_num(rmd_hi_med, 1),
             `RMD neutral (mo)` = fmt_num(rmd_lo_med, 1),
             `Horizon (mo)` = horizon, `Tail mass` = fmt_num(tail_mass, 3),
             `P(longer)` = fmt_pct(prob_longer)),
         sprintf("%s — restricted-mean-duration ratio vs. neutral (over %d mo; bold = CrI excludes 1)",
                 trk, e$rmd_ratio$horizon[1]),
         pack_by = "Region")
}
```

## Historical smoothing (simulation)

Median + 95% across replicates. "Mean monthly" = per-replicate mean over months
of the scope's monthly total, then summarised across replicates. Metric
(cases / onsets) is shown as columns.

```{r}
#| label: s-smoothing
#| results: asis
s <- R_("results_report_smoothing")
METRIC_REN <- c(`Cases (med, 95%)` = "cases", `Onsets (med, 95%)` = "onsets")
fmt_metric <- function(d) mutate(d, val = fmt_by_quantity(metric, med, lo, hi))

emit(report_wide(fmt_metric(s$monthly_overall), "scope", "metric", "val",
                 levels = list(scope = LV$scope), rename = c(Scope = "scope", METRIC_REN)),
     "Mean monthly outbreaks / cases — overall, by scope")

emit(report_wide(fmt_metric(s$monthly_by_phase) |>
                   mutate(phase = recode(phase, nina = "La Niña", neutral = "Neutral", elnino = "El Niño")),
                 c("scope", "phase"), "metric", "val",
                 levels = list(scope = LV$scope, phase = c("La Niña", "Neutral", "El Niño")),
                 rename = c(Scope = "scope", Phase = "phase", METRIC_REN)),
     paste0("Mean monthly outbreaks / cases — by ",
            if (is.null(s$phase_rule)) "ONI threshold phase (±0.5, no persistence)" else s$phase_rule$label),
     pack_by = "Scope")

emit(report_wide(fmt_metric(filter(s$monthly_by_year, scope == "Africa")), "year", "metric", "val",
                 rename = c(Year = "year", METRIC_REN)),
     "Mean monthly outbreaks / cases — Africa, by year (region splits in the artefact)")
```

## Forecast vs. counterfactual (simulation)

Median + 95% across replicates. Ratios are per-replicate paired
forecast ÷ counterfactual over each group's own attribution horizon (Africa over
the Africa window of Section 5, `r AW$label`, paired on replicate ids common to every group).
Tables below show the **`r MAIN_SET`** counterfactual set unless stated; other
sets are in the artefact. Forecast vs. counterfactual is shown as columns where
both arms appear in the same table. The artefact also keeps the former
threshold-population tables (`pop_grid`, `pop_shift`); the population in ADM1s
with more ENSO-attributable cases is the next subsection; the headline numbers are Section 5.

```{r}
#| label: s-forecast
#| results: asis
SCEN_MAIN <- LV$scenario(MAIN_SET)
scen <- function(d, levels) mutate(d, Scenario = factor(scenario_lab(run, analog_set), levels = levels))
qty  <- function(d) mutate(d, val = fmt_by_quantity(quantity, med, lo, hi),
                           Quantity = factor(QUANTITY_LABELS[quantity], levels = QUANTITY_LABELS))

emit(f$horizon_totals |>
       filter(is.na(analog_set) | analog_set == MAIN_SET, level != "country") |>
       scen(SCEN_MAIN) |> qty() |>
       report_wide(c("level", "scope", "Quantity"), "Scenario", "val",
                   rename = c(Level = "level", Scope = "scope")),
     "Horizon totals — continent + region (country rows in the artefact)",
     pack_by = "Scope")

ratio_tab <- function(d, cap)
  emit(report_wide(mutate(filter(d, analog_set == MAIN_SET), val = fmt_ratio_prob(med, lo, hi, prob_increase)),
                   c("level", "scope"), "metric", "val",
                   rename = c(Level = "level", Scope = "scope", Cases = "cases", Onsets = "onsets")),
       cap, pack_by = "Level")
ratio_tab(f$cum_ratio,
          "Cumulative forecast ÷ counterfactual ratio (med, 95% CI; [P(increase)]; bold = CI excludes 1)")
ratio_tab(f$peak_ratio,
          "Peak (per-replicate max monthly) forecast ÷ counterfactual ratio (med, 95% CI; [P(increase)]; bold = CI excludes 1)")
```

### Predicted burden by scenario (all analog sets)

Total cases over each scope's horizon window and the **annualised incidence**
per 100,000 person-years (window total ÷ simulated months × 12 ÷ population), so
scopes with different horizons compare directly. Median + 95% across
replicates; every scenario (forecast and each counterfactual analog set) is a
column. The denominator is the population of the simulated gids
`r if (identical(f$rate_pop_year, "window")) "averaged over the months of each window (month-weighted, results.derivation.rate_pop_year: window)" else paste("at the reference year", f$pop_ref_year)`
(Table below the burden tables). The simulator resolved its population at
`r if (is.null(f$sim_pop_year)) "2020 for every month (simulator.location_frame.pop_year default)" else paste0("simulator.location_frame.pop_year = ", f$sim_pop_year)`.

```{r}

burden <- f$horizon_totals |>

     pack_by = "Scope")

emit(burden |> filter(level == "country") |>
       mutate(region = factor(region, levels = LV$region)) |>

                   rename = c(Region = "region", Country = "scope")) |>
       with_afro("Country"),
     "Predicted total cases and annualised incidence (/100k person-years) — by country, all scenarios (med, 95%)",
     pack_by = "Region")

emit(f$scope_pop |>
       filter(level != "country") |>
       left_join(select(f$n_months, level, scope, n_months, n_months_window), by = c("level", "scope")) |>
       mutate(scope = factor(scope, levels = LV$scope)) |>
       arrange(scope) |>
       transmute(Scope = scope, `Months simulated` = fmt_int(n_months),
                 `Months in window` = fmt_int(n_months_window),
                 Population = fmt_pop(pop, digits = 1), `Simulated gids` = fmt_int(n_gid),
                 `Gids missing pop` = fmt_int(n_gid_pop_missing),
                 `ADM1 gids with ADM2 children` = fmt_int(n_gid_adm1_overlap)),
     "Incidence denominators — months simulated in each horizon window and simulated-gid population (country rows in the artefact)")
```

## Population in ADM1s with more ENSO-attributable cases (all cells)

```{r}
#| label: s-ae-load
ae <- R_("results_report_attrib_exposure", sets = SETS)
HLA <- RES$style$attrib_headline
if (is.null(HLA) || !.has(ae$magnitudes, HLA$magnitude))
  stop("results.style.attrib_headline$magnitude must be one of thresholds.attrib_magnitudes {",
       paste(ae$magnitudes, collapse = ", "), "}.", call. = FALSE)
HLA_M <- ae$magnitudes[which.min(abs(ae$magnitudes - as.numeric(HLA$magnitude)))]
CLASS_LAB <- c(childs = "Childs (mean ratio ≥ 1 + m)", childs_median = "Childs, ratio of medians",
               robust = "IPCC robust", conflicting = "IPCC conflicting", none = "IPCC no robust signal")
# Every table below is the headline slice (HL_WIN x HL_EXPLOSIVE, the
# results.style.attrib_headline cell) unless it says otherwise; ax_all keeps
# the other cells.
ax_all <- ae$exposure |>
  mutate(cls = factor(CLASS_LAB[class], levels = CLASS_LAB),
         mag = factor(fmt_pct(magnitude), levels = fmt_pct(ae$magnitudes)),
         scope = factor(as.character(scope), levels = unique(c(LV$scope, sort(as.character(scope))))))
# With results.af_posterior the Childs class reports the posterior mean and
# 95% CrI of the per-draw Childs population over the identified ADM1s
# (attrib_exposure_posterior, variant adj; as the main text and
# table S11), for every cell, level and scope; ratio of medians unchanged.
if (AF_POST) {
  apx <- R_("results_attrib_exposure_posterior", sets = SETS)$exposure |>
    filter(variant == "adj") |>
    transmute(window, explosive_guard, metric, magnitude, level, scope = as.character(scope), analog_set,
              q_pop = pop_mean, q_pct = pct_mean, q_n = n_adm1_mean, q_lo = pop_lo, q_hi = pop_hi,
              q_pct_lo = pct_lo, q_pct_hi = pct_hi, class = "childs")
  ax_all <- ax_all |>
    mutate(scope_chr = as.character(scope)) |>
    left_join(apx, by = c("window", "explosive_guard", "metric", "magnitude", "level",
                           "scope_chr" = "scope", "analog_set", "class")) |>
    mutate(post = class == "childs" & !is.na(q_pop),
           pop = ifelse(post, q_pop, pop), pct = ifelse(post, q_pct, pct), n_adm1 = ifelse(post, q_n, n_adm1),
           pop_lo = ifelse(post, q_lo, pop_lo), pop_hi = ifelse(post, q_hi, pop_hi),
           pct_lo = ifelse(post, q_pct_lo, pct_lo), pct_hi = ifelse(post, q_pct_hi, pct_hi)) |>
    select(-scope_chr, -starts_with("q_"))
  CLASS_LAB[["childs"]] <- "Childs (posterior mean, 95% CrI)"
  ax_all <- mutate(ax_all, cls = factor(CLASS_LAB[class], levels = CLASS_LAB))
} else ax_all$post <- FALSE
ax <- filter(ax_all, window == HL_WIN, explosive_guard == HL_GUARD)
# The Childs population's paired-bootstrap interval exists only when
# results.derivation.attrib_boot_b > 0; with B = 0 the point is shown alone
# (the posterior rows carry their CrI either way).
BOOT_AE <- isTRUE(ae$n_boot > 0)
ax_val <- function(d) mutate(d, val = ifelse((BOOT_AE & class %in% c("childs", "childs_median")) | post,
  sprintf("%s [%s; %s ADM1]", fmt_pct(pct, 1), fmt_pop_ci(pop, pop_lo, pop_hi, 1), fmt_int(n_adm1)),
  sprintf("%s [%s; %s ADM1]", fmt_pct(pct, 1), fmt_pop(pop, 1), fmt_int(n_adm1))))
at_m <- function(d, m) filter(d, abs(magnitude - m) < 1e-9)
unlab4c <- function(d) select(d, -any_of(c("cls", "mag", "val")))
```

Forecast vs. counterfactual per ADM1, over the attribution window and runs of the forecast tables above,
with replicates **paired** by id: the two arms of a replicate share its
smoothing handoff state and its posterior draw, so their difference is the
ENSO effect plus epidemic noise. Headline: `r paste0(EXPL_LAB, if (HL_GUARD) "; a dropped replicate leaves every ADM1 of its group" else "")` (the
other explosive mode is a sensitivity; Data S1, D24 lists the dropped pairs). For each magnitude m:

- **Childs** (the impact-attribution convention of Childs et al. 2025): an ADM1
  counts when its mean forecast total is positive and at least (1 + m) × its
  mean counterfactual total (a zero counterfactual with a positive forecast is
  an infinite ratio and counts; 0 vs 0 has no ratio and does not). Point
  population`r if (BOOT_AE) sprintf(", with a 95%% interval from %d paired bootstrap resamples of the replicate ids within each group (Monte-Carlo precision)", ae$n_boot) else " (the paired bootstrap is off, results.derivation.attrib_boot_b = 0: no interval)"`.
- **Childs, ratio of medians**: the same rule on the median replicate totals,
  insensitive to the heavy upper tail of the replicates (a few explosive
  outbreaks lift a mean ratio well above the typical replicate's). Where the
  typical counterfactual replicate has no outbreak but the typical forecast
  replicate does, the ratio is infinite and the ADM1 counts.
- **IPCC robustness** (AR6 Atlas, m as the variability threshold): **robust**
  when ≥ `r fmt_pct(ae$robust_exceed)` of the paired replicates have forecast >
  (1 + m) × counterfactual **and** ≥ `r fmt_pct(ae$robust_agree)` have forecast >
  counterfactual (ties disagree); **conflicting** when only the first holds;
  **no robust signal** otherwise. No interval.

Population is the observed sub-unit population at `r ae$pop_ref_year`; shares
are of the scope's simulated ADM1 population. Two sensitivities are derived
alongside the headline slice: the **post-fork window** (from the factual launch
`r format(ae$windows[["post_fork"]])`; before it the factual series is the
smoothing, conditioned on the surveillance data, while the counterfactual is
simulated) and the **other explosive mode** (`r if (HL_GUARD) "every replicate kept" else "explosive pairs dropped"`).

```{r}
#| label: s-ae
#| results: asis
emit(ax |> filter(level != "country", analog_set == MAIN_SET) |> at_m(HLA_M) |> ax_val() |>
       report_wide(c("scope", "cls"), "metric", "val",
                   rename = c(Scope = "scope", Estimand = "cls", Cases = "cases", Onsets = "onsets")),
     sprintf("Population in ADM1s with more ENSO-attributable cases / onsets at m = %s, counterfactual set %s — Africa + by region (share [population%s; N ADM1])",
             fmt_pct(HLA_M), MAIN_SET, if (BOOT_AE) ", Childs with 95% bootstrap interval" else ""),
     pack_by = "Scope",
     raw = unlab4c(ax |> filter(level != "country", analog_set == MAIN_SET) |> at_m(HLA_M)))

for (mt in c("cases", "onsets"))
  emit(ax |> filter(level != "country", analog_set == MAIN_SET, metric == mt) |> ax_val() |>
         report_wide(c("scope", "mag"), "cls", "val", rename = c(Scope = "scope", `m` = "mag")),
       sprintf("Population in ADM1s with more ENSO-attributable %s, every magnitude m, counterfactual set %s — Africa + by region (share [population; N ADM1])",
               mt, MAIN_SET),

emit(ax |> filter(level == "continent") |> at_m(HLA_M) |> ax_val() |>

emit(ax_all |> filter(level == "continent", analog_set == MAIN_SET, class != "none") |> at_m(HLA_M) |>
       ax_val() |>
       mutate(cell = paste0(WIN_LAB[window], if_else(explosive_guard, ", explosive pairs dropped", ", every pair kept")),

             fmt_pct(HLA_M), MAIN_SET),
```

## Attribution metrics: attributable fraction, probability ratio, signal-to-noise

```{r}
#| label: s-am-load
am <- R_("results_report_attrib_metrics", sets = SETS)
HLM <- RES$style$attrib_metrics_headline
if (is.null(HLM) || !.has(am$sn_levels, HLM$sn_level) || !isTRUE(HLM$pr_event %in% c("onset_any", "cases_ge")))
  stop("results.style.attrib_metrics_headline: sn_level must be one of thresholds.sn_levels {",
       paste(am$sn_levels, collapse = ", "), "} and pr_event one of onset_any, cases_ge.", call. = FALSE)
HLM_L <- am$sn_levels[which.min(abs(am$sn_levels - as.numeric(HLM$sn_level)))]
EV_LAB <- c(onset_any = "any onset in the window",
            cases_ge  = sprintf("window cases ≥ %s", format(am$pr_case_threshold, big.mark = ",")))
SN_DIR_LAB <- c(increase = "S/N ≥ +L (more)", decrease = "S/N ≤ −L (fewer)", either = "|S/N| ≥ L")
hl4d <- function(d) filter(d, window == HL_WIN, explosive_guard == HL_GUARD)
lvl4d <- function(d) mutate(d, scope = factor(as.character(scope),
                                              levels = unique(c(LV$scope, sort(as.character(scope))))))
af_hl  <- hl4d(am$af_scope) |> filter(level == "continent", analog_set == MAIN_SET)
pr_hl  <- hl4d(am$pr_scope) |> filter(level == "continent", analog_set == MAIN_SET, event == HLM$pr_event)
sn_hl  <- hl4d(am$sn_pop) |> filter(level == "continent", analog_set == MAIN_SET, abs(sn_level - HLM_L) < 1e-9)
BOOT_AM <- isTRUE(am$n_boot > 0)
# AF / AN with their interval: af_posterior when results.af_posterior (its cell
# = the window), else the paired bootstrap of the replicate means. The means,
# AN per 100k and every other column stay report_attrib_metrics'.
am_af <- if (AF_POST) {
  am$af_scope |> filter(level != "country") |>
    select(window, explosive_guard, level, scope, metric, analog_set, mean_f, mean_cf, an_per_100k) |>
    left_join(R_("results_af_posterior", sets = SETS)$scope |> filter(level != "country") |> af_rows(TRUE) |>
                transmute(window = cell, explosive_guard, level, scope, metric, analog_set,
                          af, af_lo, af_hi, an, an_lo, an_hi),
              by = c("window", "explosive_guard", "level", "scope", "metric", "analog_set"))
} else af_rows(filter(am$af_scope, level != "country"), FALSE)
# PR with its interval where one exists (the exact bound when p0 = 0 always; the
# bootstrap otherwise only when attrib_boot_b > 0), else the point alone.
fmt_pr <- function(pr, lo, hi) ifelse(is.na(lo) & is.na(hi), .fmt_num_inf(pr, 1), fmt_ratio_inf(pr, lo, hi))
```

Three attribution families from the same paired runs, window and explosive
guard as the previous subsection (headline slice: `r WIN_LAB[[HL_WIN]] %||% HL_WIN`, `r EXPL_LAB`,
counterfactual set `r MAIN_SET`), so that one can be retained for the manuscript:

- **Attributable number and fraction** (AN = forecast − counterfactual,
  AF = AN / forecast; the health impact-attribution convention), with the
  `r INT_LAB`; scope totals are sums of their ADM1s per replicate.
- **Probability ratio** PR = p1 / p0 of an outbreak event in the window (World
  Weather Attribution), with FAR = 1 − 1/PR (= the probability of necessary
  causation, PN), the probability of sufficient causation PS = (p1 − p0)/(1 − p0)
  and PNS = p1 − p0 (Hannart & Naveau). Events: `r EV_LAB[["onset_any"]]`; and
  `r EV_LAB[["cases_ge"]]` (the database's outbreak-size convention). When no
  counterfactual replicate has the event, PR is infinite (∞) and its lower bound is
  p1 over the exact one-sided `r fmt_pct(1 - am$pr_alpha)` upper bound on p0.
  At large scopes both arms almost always have the event (PR → 1): the
  probability ratio is informative at ADM1 and country level.
- **Signal-to-noise** S/N = mean / sd of the paired difference across replicates
  (Hawkins & Sutton), and the population of the ADM1s where the signal has
  emerged (|S/N| ≥ L, L ∈ {`r paste(am$sn_levels, collapse = ", ")`}); a
  threshold-free companion of the IPCC robustness classes.


```{r}
#| label: s-am
#| results: asis
emit(hl4d(am_af) |> filter(analog_set == MAIN_SET) |> lvl4d() |>
       mutate(AN = fmt_an(metric, an, an_lo, an_hi),
              AF = fmt_af(af, af_lo, af_hi),
              `AN per 100k` = fmt_num(an_per_100k, 1)) |>
       arrange(metric, scope) |>
       transmute(Metric = metric, Scope = scope, `Forecast (mean)` = ifelse(metric == "onsets", fmt_num(mean_f, 1), fmt_cases(mean_f)),
                 `Counterfactual (mean)` = ifelse(metric == "onsets", fmt_num(mean_cf, 1), fmt_cases(mean_cf)),
                 AN, AF, `AN per 100k`),
     sprintf("Attributable number and fraction of cases and onsets, forecast vs counterfactual (%s) — Africa and regions (%s)", MAIN_SET, INT_LAB),
     pack_by = "Metric", slug = "D19_attrib_af_scope", raw = am_af)

emit(hl4d(am$pr_scope) |> filter(analog_set == MAIN_SET, level != "continent") |> lvl4d() |>
       mutate(region = factor(region, levels = LV$region)) |>
       arrange(event, region, level, scope) |>
       transmute(Event = EV_LAB[event], Scope = scope, Level = level,
                 p1 = fmt_pct(p1), p0 = fmt_pct(p0),
                 PR = fmt_pr(pr, pr_lo, pr_hi), `FAR (PN)` = fmt_num(far, 2),
                 PS = fmt_num(ps, 2), PNS = fmt_num(pns, 2)),
     sprintf("Probability ratio of an outbreak event and probabilities of causation — regions and countries (%s; bold: 95%% interval excludes 1%s)", MAIN_SET,
             if (BOOT_AM) "" else "; interval only where p0 = 0 (exact bound), the bootstrap is off"),
     pack_by = "Event", slug = "D20_attrib_pr_scope", raw = am$pr_scope)

emit(hl4d(am$pr_pop) |> filter(analog_set == MAIN_SET, level != "country", BOOT_AM | rule == "point") |> lvl4d() |>
       mutate(val = sprintf("%s [%s; %s ADM1]", fmt_pct(pct, 1), fmt_pop(pop, 1), fmt_int(n_adm1)),
              rule = c(point = "PR > 1", lower = "95% lower bound of PR > 1")[rule], event = EV_LAB[event]) |>
       report_wide(c("event", "scope"), "rule", "val", rename = c(Event = "event", Scope = "scope")),
     sprintf("Population in ADM1s where the outbreak event is more likely under the forecast (%s)", MAIN_SET),
     pack_by = "Event", slug = "D20_attrib_pr_pop", raw = am$pr_pop)

emit(hl4d(am$sn_pop) |> filter(analog_set == MAIN_SET, level != "country") |> lvl4d() |>
       mutate(val = sprintf("%s [%s; %s ADM1]", fmt_pct(pct, 1), fmt_pop(pop, 1), fmt_int(n_adm1)),
              col = sprintf("L = %s: %s", sn_level, SN_DIR_LAB[direction])) |>
       report_wide(c("metric", "scope"), "col", "val", rename = c(Metric = "metric", Scope = "scope")),
     sprintf("Population in ADM1s where the forecast-vs-counterfactual signal has emerged (|S/N| ≥ L; %s)", MAIN_SET),
     pack_by = "Metric", slug = "D21_attrib_sn_pop", raw = am$sn_pop)

emit(am_af |> filter(level == "continent", analog_set == MAIN_SET) |>
       mutate(cell = paste(WIN_LAB[window], ifelse(explosive_guard, "explosive dropped", "explosive kept"), sep = ", "),
              val = sprintf("AN %s | AF %s", fmt_an(metric, an, an_lo, an_hi), fmt_af(af, af_lo, af_hi))) |>
       report_wide("metric", "cell", "val", rename = c(Metric = "metric")),
     sprintf("Attributable number and fraction, Africa — window × explosive-guard sensitivity (%s; per-ADM1 AF in the CSV)", INT_LAB),
     slug = "D19_attrib_af_adm1", raw = am$af_adm1)

emit(hl4d(am$sn_scope) |> filter(analog_set == MAIN_SET, level != "country") |> lvl4d() |>
       arrange(metric, scope) |>
       transmute(Metric = metric, Scope = scope, `Mean difference` = ifelse(metric == "onsets", fmt_num(mean_diff, 1), fmt_cases(mean_diff)),
                 `SD across replicates` = ifelse(metric == "onsets", fmt_num(sd_diff, 1), fmt_cases(sd_diff)),
                 `S/N` = fmt_num(sn, 2), `P(forecast > counterfactual)` = fmt_pct(p_sign)),
     sprintf("Signal-to-noise of the paired difference — Africa and regions (%s; per-ADM1 values in the CSVs)", MAIN_SET),
     pack_by = "Metric", slug = "D21_attrib_sn_scope", raw = am$sn_scope)
# Per-ADM1 PR and S/N tables: CSV only (too long for the report).
if (nzchar(TABLES_DIR)) {
  note_caption("D20_attrib_pr_adm1", "Forecast attribution, probability ratio per ADM1: one row per window x explosive guard x ADM1 x outbreak event (event: onset_any / cases_ge) x analogue set; p1 / p0 the factual / counterfactual probabilities of the event, PR, PN (far), PS and PNS")
  report_write_csv(am$pr_adm1, file.path(TABLES_DIR, "D20_attrib_pr_adm1.csv"))
  note_caption("D21_attrib_sn_adm1", "Forecast attribution, signal-to-noise per ADM1: one row per window x explosive guard x ADM1 x metric x analogue set; mean and SD of the paired factual - counterfactual difference, their ratio sn, and the share of pairs with the sign of the mean (p_sign)")
  report_write_csv(am$sn_adm1, file.path(TABLES_DIR, "D21_attrib_sn_adm1.csv"))
}
```

`r if (!INFO_ON) "Not derived: the attribution uses the displayed factual (no results.inputs.attrib_manifest), or results.af_posterior is off." else sprintf("Three factual / counterfactual pairs share every replicate's smoothing replicate and posterior draw: **total** = displayed factual (launched %s, earlier months from the smoothing) − counterfactual; **information** = displayed factual − attribution factual (launched %s); **ENSO** = attribution factual − counterfactual, the headline attribution. The attributable numbers add (total = information + ENSO, up to replicates the explosive guard drops differently per pair; the gap column), the fractions do not. Both factuals start each replicate from the same smoothing replicate; the attribution factual from its %s state, which the smoother traced back from the data up to the displayed factual's launch, so the information component measures the realised trajectory of the months between the two launches against their re-simulation, not the value of those months' data alone. %s.", format(as.Date(ai$display_factual_start), "%B %Y"), format(as.Date(ai$attrib_factual_start), "%B %Y"), format(as.Date(ai$attrib_factual_start) - 1, "%B %Y"), INT_LAB)`

```{r}

  filter(cell == HL_WIN, explosive_guard == HL_GUARD, level != "country",
         analog_set %in% c(MAIN_SET, "information")) |>
  af_rows(TRUE) |>
  mutate(Scope = scope_fct(scope_lab(level, region)),
         Component = factor(COMP_LAB[component], levels = COMP_LAB))
emit(info_rows |> arrange(Component, Scope) |> af_wide(c("Component", "Scope"), character(0)),
     sprintf("Decomposition of the forecast attribution over the headline window (counterfactual %s, %s) — Africa + by ENSO group (AF and AN, %s; bold = interval excludes 0)",
             MAIN_SET, EXPL_LAB, INT_LAB),
     pack_by = "Component", slug = "D22_attrib_information_scope", raw = info_rows)
emit(ai$decomposition |>
       filter(cell == HL_WIN, explosive_guard == HL_GUARD, level != "country", analog_set == MAIN_SET) |>
       mutate(Scope = scope_fct(as.character(scope)),

       arrange(metric, Scope) |>
       transmute(metric, Scope, Total = total, Information = information, ENSO = enso, Gap = gap),

if (nzchar(TABLES_DIR)) {

  report_write_csv(filter(ai$scope, level == "country"),
```

## Africa window of the forecast attribution

Africa (results.scope.africa): `r if (AW_COMMON) sprintf("every included ENSO group over %s; a group whose firm horizon ends earlier is read on into the simulated analog continuation of ENSO (continuation_max_lead %s%s).", AW$label, if (is.finite(AW$max_lead)) AW$max_lead else "to_end", if (nzchar(AW$max_cf_winter %||% "")) sprintf(", no ONI read past DJF %s", AW$max_cf_winter) else "") else sprintf("the legacy windows (Africa ribbon and forecast totals to %s; the attribution metrics sum each group over its own firm window).", format(AW$end, "%B %Y"))`
Continuation lead of a track = the ONI month it reads at the group's last
month (month − lag) minus the last month of the firm ENSO forecast
(`r format(a28$firm_oni_end[1], "%B %Y")`); the CRPSS is the analog
continuation's skill against climatology at that lead (perfect-seam
re-forecasts, so optimistic). `r CAVEAT_TXT`

```{r}
#| label: s-africa-scope
#| results: asis
emit(a28 |>
       transmute(`ENSO group` = GRP_LAB5(enso_group), Countries = fmt_int(n_countries),
                 `Firm horizon` = format(firm_horizon, "%Y-%m"), `End in window` = format(group_end, "%Y-%m"),
                 `Months past firm` = fmt_int(months_past_firm),
                 `Occurrence lead (CRPSS)` = ifelse(lead_occurrence > 0, sprintf("%d (%s)", lead_occurrence,
                   ifelse(is.na(crpss_occurrence), "n/a", fmt_num(crpss_occurrence, 2))), "0"),
                 `Duration lead (CRPSS)` = ifelse(lead_duration > 0, sprintf("%d (%s)", lead_duration,
                   ifelse(is.na(crpss_duration), "n/a", fmt_num(crpss_duration, 2))), "0"),
                 `Monthly lead (CRPSS)` = ifelse(lead_monthly > 0, sprintf("%d (%s)", lead_monthly,
                   ifelse(is.na(crpss_monthly), "n/a", fmt_num(crpss_monthly, 2))), "0"),
                 `Counterfactual winters read` = cf_winters_read,
                 `Unconstrained winters` = ifelse(nzchar(cf_winters_unconstrained), cf_winters_unconstrained, "—")),
     sprintf("Definition of Africa for the forecast attribution: each ENSO group's window, its longest continuation lead per track (analog CRPSS vs climatology at that lead) and the counterfactual DJF winters its window reads (constrained: %s)",
             a28$cf_winter_constrained[1] %||% "n/a"),
     slug = "D23_africa_scope", raw = a28)
```
