## Explosive replicates

A replicate whose group window cases reach the cap
(`r format(EXPL_CAP, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)`) in either arm is dropped from that
group's pair under the "drop" mode, and from Africa when it is explosive in any group. Dropping
on the outcome is not neutral: where ENSO raises incidence the factual arm reaches the cap more
often, so the guard pulls the attributable fraction towards 0. The table gives, per window and
scope, the pairs dropped because of the factual arm only (F only), the counterfactual only (CF
only) or both, the exact sign test of F-only against CF-only drops, the attributable cases of the
dropped pairs and the AF with every pair minus the AF with the kept pairs (AF of the mean cases).
Headline: `r EXPL_LAB`.

```{r}
#| label: s-explosive
#| results: asis
ea29 <- if (EV_ON) R_("results_report_event_attrib") else NULL
ex29 <- bind_rows(
  mutate(am$explosive_summary, source = paste0("forecast (", ifelse(factual == "attrib", "attribution factual", "displayed factual"), ")")),
  if (INFO_ON && !is.null(ai$explosive_summary))
    mutate(ai$explosive_summary, source = ifelse(comparison == "stitched_vs_cf", "displayed vs counterfactual",
                                                 "displayed vs attribution factual")),
  if (!is.null(ea29$explosive_summary))
    mutate(ea29$explosive_summary, source = paste0("event ", event, " (factual = ", factual_source, ")")))
emit(ex29 |> filter(analog_set %in% c(MAIN_SET, "information"), window %in% c(HL_WIN, unique(ea29$explosive_summary$window))) |>
       mutate(Scope = ifelse(level == "continent", "Africa", GRP_LAB5(scope))) |>
       transmute(Source = source, Window = window, Scope,
                 `Pairs` = fmt_int(n_pairs), `F only` = fmt_int(n_drop_f_only), `CF only` = fmt_int(n_drop_cf_only),
                 Both = fmt_int(n_drop_both), Kept = fmt_int(n_pairs_kept), `Share dropped` = fmt_pct(share_dropped, 1),
                 `Sign test p` = fmt_num(sign_p, 3), `AN of dropped (cases)` = fmt_int(round(an_dropped)),
                 `AF none − AF drop` = fmt_pct(af_none_minus_drop, 1)),
     sprintf("Explosive pairs (cap %s, counterfactual set %s; headline window for the forecast) — what the drop mode removes, per arm, and its effect on the AF of cases (every window and set in the CSV)",
             format(EXPL_CAP, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE), MAIN_SET),
     pack_by = "Source", slug = "D24_explosive_pairs", raw = ex29)
```

## Attribution of past strong ENSO events (all readings)

```{r}
#| label: s-ev-load
ea <- if (EV_ON) R_("results_report_event_attrib") else NULL
eam <- if (EV_ON) R_("results_report_event_af_model") else NULL
# AF / AN per (event, factual source, guard, scope, metric): the factual =
# simulation reading takes event_af_posterior's interval when
# results.af_posterior; otherwise (and for the smoothing reading, which has no
# posterior) the paired bootstrap, i.e. the point alone when attrib_boot_b = 0.
ev_all <- NULL
if (EV_ON) {
  ev_all <- af_rows(ea$af_scope, FALSE)
  if (AF_POST) {
    ep <- R_("results_event_af_posterior")$scope |> af_rows(TRUE) |>
      transmute(event, explosive_guard, level, scope, metric, factual_source = "simulation",
                p_af = af, p_af_lo = af_lo, p_af_hi = af_hi, p_an = an, p_an_lo = an_lo, p_an_hi = an_hi)
    ev_all <- ev_all |>
      left_join(ep, by = c("event", "explosive_guard", "level", "scope", "metric", "factual_source")) |>
      mutate(post = !is.na(p_af),
             af = ifelse(post, p_af, af), af_lo = ifelse(post, p_af_lo, af_lo), af_hi = ifelse(post, p_af_hi, af_hi),
             an = ifelse(post, p_an, an), an_lo = ifelse(post, p_an_lo, an_lo), an_hi = ifelse(post, p_an_hi, an_hi)) |>
      select(-starts_with("p_"))
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: s-ev
#| results: asis
#| eval: !expr EV_ON
EVS <- ea$events
ev_lab <- setNames(sprintf("%s (launch %s)", EVS$label, format(EVS$launch, "%Y-%m")), EVS$event)
ev_fct <- function(x) factor(ev_lab[x], levels = ev_lab)
FS_LAB <- c(simulation = "factual = simulation", smoothing = "factual = smoothing")
hl_e <- function(d) filter(d, explosive_guard == HL_GUARD)
cat(sprintf(paste0(
  "\n\nEach strong event is attributed by a pair of runs per simulation unit handed off from the ",
  "historical smoothing at the event launch (the month before ONI crossed ±0.5 into the event): ",
  "the factual arm with observed ENSO, the counterfactual with Lenssen piControl analogs matched to ",
  "the launch ONI and classified **%s** at the event's peak DJF. Each fit group's window ends with the ",
  "cholera season containing the peak, plus its largest positive deployed lag. Two factual readings, ",
  "both headline candidates: the free simulation, and the smoothing (each replicate's factual series ",
  "is the smoothing replicate it was handed off from; data-conditioned, so model misfit enters the ",
  "contrast). AF / AN: factual = simulation with the %s; factual = smoothing %s. Explosive replicates ",
  "dropped unless stated. AN_obs = AF × the observed window total.%s%s\n\n"),
  ea$analog_set, INT_LAB,
  if (isTRUE(ea$n_boot > 0)) sprintf("with the 95%% paired-bootstrap interval (%d resamples)", ea$n_boot)
  else "as a point estimate (no posterior interval for this reading; bootstrap off)",
  if (any(grepl("^lanina_202[012]$", EVS$event)))
    " The 2020-23 La Niña as three annual launches: their windows overlap, per-launch numbers are not additive." else "",
  if (!is.null(ea$sub_windows))
    paste0(" A multi-winter event is one launch (its counterfactual analogs neutral in every winter it ",
           "spans) read in consecutive per-winter sub-windows, reported after these tables.") else ""))

if (AF_POST) {
  ni_ev <- af_unidentified_txt(hl_e(R_("results_event_af_posterior")$scope), "Past events")
  if (nzchar(ni_ev)) cat(ni_ev, "\n\n")
}
emit(EVS |> left_join(ea$group_windows |> group_by(event) |>
                        summarise(windows = paste(sprintf("%s %s", grp_token(enso_group),
                                                          format(window_end, "%Y-%m")), collapse = ", ")),
                      by = "event") |>
       transmute(Event = label, Launch = format(launch, "%Y-%m"), Peak = format(peak, "%Y-%m"),
                 `Window end by group` = windows, `Analogs in set` = fmt_int(lenssen_n_set)),
     "Past strong ENSO events: launch, peak and per-group window end", slug = "D13_event_attrib_events", raw = ea$events)

emit(hl_e(ev_all) |> filter(level == "continent") |>
       mutate(Event = ev_fct(event), val = sprintf("%s | AF %s", fmt_an(metric, an, an_lo, an_hi),
                                                   fmt_af(af, af_lo, af_hi)),
              col = paste(metric, FS_LAB[factual_source], sep = ", ")) |>
       report_wide("Event", "col", "val"),
     "ENSO-attributable cases and onsets per event, Africa: AN | AF, both factual readings (intervals as stated above; bold = interval excludes 0)",
     slug = "D13_event_attrib_af_scope", raw = ev_all)

emit(hl_e(ev_all) |> filter(level == "region") |>
       mutate(Event = ev_fct(event), region = factor(region, levels = LV$region),
              val = fmt_af(af, af_lo, af_hi),
              col = paste(metric, FS_LAB[factual_source], sep = ", ")) |>
       arrange(Event, region) |>
       report_wide(c("Event", "region"), "col", "val", rename = c(Region = "region")),
     "Attributable fraction by ENSO group and event, both factual readings (intervals as stated above)", pack_by = "Event")

# AN_obs = AF x observed: with the posterior AF, its interval is the AF interval
# times the (fixed) observed total.
an_obs <- ea$an_observed |> filter(explosive_guard == HL_GUARD, level != "country", factual_source == "simulation")
if (AF_POST)
  an_obs <- an_obs |>
    left_join(transmute(filter(ev_all, post), event, explosive_guard, level, scope, metric, factual_source,
                        pa = af, pa_lo = af_lo, pa_hi = af_hi),
              by = intersect(c("event", "explosive_guard", "level", "scope", "metric", "factual_source"), names(an_obs))) |>
    mutate(an_obs    = ifelse(is.na(pa), an_obs, pa * observed),
           an_obs_lo = ifelse(is.na(pa), an_obs_lo, pa_lo * observed),
           an_obs_hi = ifelse(is.na(pa), an_obs_hi, pa_hi * observed)) |>
    select(-pa, -pa_lo, -pa_hi)
emit(an_obs |>
       mutate(Event = ev_fct(event), Scope = ifelse(level == "continent", "Africa", region),
              val = ifelse(metric == "onsets",
                           sprintf("obs %s; AN_obs %s; obs/F %s; cover %s", fmt_num(observed, 0),
                                   fmt_an("onsets", an_obs, an_obs_lo, an_obs_hi), fmt_num(obs_over_f, 2), fmt_pct(cover)),
                           sprintf("obs %s; AN_obs %s; obs/F %s; cover %s", fmt_cases(observed),
                                   fmt_an("cases", an_obs, an_obs_lo, an_obs_hi), fmt_num(obs_over_f, 2), fmt_pct(cover)))) |>
       report_wide(c("Event", "Scope"), "metric", "val"),
     paste("Observed window totals, observed-anchored attributable number (AF of the simulated factual",
           "× observed), observed ÷ simulated factual mean (skill) and surveillance coverage (share of the",
           "simulated gid-months with a survival-panel row)"),
     pack_by = "Event", slug = "D16_event_attrib_observed", raw = an_obs)

emit(ev_all |> filter(level == "continent") |>
       mutate(Event = ev_fct(event),
              col = paste(FS_LAB[factual_source], ifelse(explosive_guard, "explosive dropped", "explosive kept"), sep = ", "),
              val = paste(metric, fmt_af(af, af_lo, af_hi))) |>
       group_by(Event, col) |> summarise(val = paste(val, collapse = "; "), .groups = "drop") |>
       report_wide("Event", "col", "val"),
     "Attributable fraction, Africa — factual reading × explosive-guard sensitivity")

emit(hl_e(ea$pr_scope) |> filter(level == "region", factual_source == "simulation", pr_event == HLM$pr_event) |>
       mutate(Event = ev_fct(event), region = factor(region, levels = LV$region),
              val = sprintf("PR %s; p1 %s / p0 %s", fmt_pr(pr, pr_lo, pr_hi), fmt_pct(p1), fmt_pct(p0))) |>
       arrange(Event, region) |>
       report_wide(c("Event", "region"), "event", "val", rename = c(Region = "region")),
     paste0("Probability ratio of an outbreak event (", EV_LAB[[HLM$pr_event]], ") per ENSO group (factual = simulation)"),
     pack_by = "Event", slug = "D14_event_attrib_pr_scope", raw = ea$pr_scope)

emit(hl_e(ea$sn_scope) |> filter(level != "country") |>
       mutate(Event = ev_fct(event), Scope = ifelse(level == "continent", "Africa", region),
              val = sprintf("%s [P>0 %s]", fmt_num(sn, 2), fmt_pct(p_sign)),
              col = paste(metric, FS_LAB[factual_source], sep = ", ")) |>
       report_wide(c("Event", "Scope"), "col", "val"),
     "Signal-to-noise of the paired difference per event (P>0: share of replicates with more under the factual)",
     pack_by = "Event", slug = "D15_event_attrib_sn_scope", raw = ea$sn_scope)

sim_af <- hl_e(ev_all) |> filter(level != "country", factual_source == "simulation") |>
  transmute(event, level, scope, metric, sim = fmt_af(af, af_lo, af_hi))
emit(eam$scope |> filter(level != "country") |>
       transmute(event, level, scope, metric, analytic = fmt_pct_ci(af_mean, af_lo, af_hi, 1),
                 observed = ifelse(metric == "onsets", fmt_num(observed, 0), fmt_cases(observed))) |>
       left_join(sim_af, by = c("event", "level", "scope", "metric")) |>
       mutate(Event = ev_fct(event), Scope = ifelse(level == "continent", "Africa", scope),
              val = sprintf("analytic %s | simulated %s [obs %s]", analytic, sim, observed)) |>
       report_wide(c("Event", "Scope"), "metric", "val"),
     paste("Analytic attributable fraction (deployed crossbasis on the observed rows, no epidemic dynamics;",
           eam$n_draws, "posterior draws × counterfactual analogs) vs the simulated AF (factual = simulation)"),
     pack_by = "Event", slug = "D17_event_af_model_scope", raw = eam$scope)

if (nzchar(TABLES_DIR)) {
  note_caption("D17_event_af_model_adm1", "Analytic attribution of the past events per ADM1 (crossbasis on the observed panel): one row per event x track x ADM1; observed total, AN and AF posterior mean with 95% interval, P(AN > 0)")
  report_write_csv(eam$adm1, file.path(TABLES_DIR, "D17_event_af_model_adm1.csv"))
  note_caption("D13_event_attrib_af_adm1", "Past-event attribution per ADM1: one row per event x factual source x explosive guard x ADM1 x metric x analogue set; factual and counterfactual means over paired replicates, AN, AF (of means) and AN per 100,000")
  report_write_csv(ea$af_adm1, file.path(TABLES_DIR, "D13_event_attrib_af_adm1.csv"))
  note_caption("D13_event_attrib_exposure", "Past-event attribution, population in ADM1s with a larger expected burden: one row per event x factual source x explosive guard x metric x magnitude x rule x scope x analogue set; number of ADM1s, population and its share of the scope")
  report_write_csv(ea$exposure, file.path(TABLES_DIR, "D13_event_attrib_exposure.csv"))
  note_caption("D14_event_attrib_pr_adm1", "Past-event attribution, probability ratio per ADM1: one row per event x factual source x explosive guard x ADM1 x outbreak event (pr_event: onset_any / cases_ge) x analogue set; p1 / p0, PR, PN (far), PS and PNS")
  report_write_csv(ea$pr_adm1, file.path(TABLES_DIR, "D14_event_attrib_pr_adm1.csv"))
  note_caption("D15_event_attrib_sn_adm1", "Past-event attribution, signal-to-noise per ADM1: one row per event x factual source x explosive guard x ADM1 x metric x analogue set; mean and SD of the paired difference, sn and p_sign")
  report_write_csv(ea$sn_adm1, file.path(TABLES_DIR, "D15_event_attrib_sn_adm1.csv"))
  note_caption("D16_event_attrib_observed_adm1", "Observed onsets and suspected cases per ADM1 over each past event's window: one row per event x ADM1, with the number of cells (months) behind each total")
  report_write_csv(ea$observed_adm1, file.path(TABLES_DIR, "D16_event_attrib_observed_adm1.csv"))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: s-ev-sub
#| results: asis
#| eval: !expr EV_ON
# Per-winter sub-windows of a multi-winter event (report_event_attrib v3,
# event_af_posterior v3, report_event_af_model v2). Only when
# the event manifest has them (schema 3).
if (!is.null(ea$sub_windows)) {
  sw <- ea$sub_windows
  sw_all <- af_rows(sw$af_scope, FALSE)
  evp_sw <- if (AF_POST) R_("results_event_af_posterior")$sub_windows else NULL
  if (!is.null(evp_sw)) {
    keys <- c("event", "sub_window", "explosive_guard", "level", "scope", "metric", "factual_source")
    sw_all <- sw_all |>
      left_join(af_rows(evp_sw$scope, TRUE) |>
                  transmute(event, sub_window, explosive_guard, level, scope, metric, factual_source = "simulation",
                            p_af = af, p_af_lo = af_lo, p_af_hi = af_hi, p_an = an, p_an_lo = an_lo, p_an_hi = an_hi),
                by = keys) |>
      mutate(post = !is.na(p_af),
             af = ifelse(post, p_af, af), af_lo = ifelse(post, p_af_lo, af_lo), af_hi = ifelse(post, p_af_hi, af_hi),
             an = ifelse(post, p_an, an), an_lo = ifelse(post, p_an_lo, an_lo), an_hi = ifelse(post, p_an_hi, an_hi)) |>
      select(-starts_with("p_"))
  }
  wl <- sw$windows |> distinct(event, sub_window, k, peak, peak_season_year) |>
    mutate(Winter = sprintf("DJF %d/%02d (peak %s)", peak_season_year, (peak_season_year + 1L) %% 100L,
                            format(peak, "%Y-%m")))
  sw_lab <- setNames(wl$Winter, paste(wl$event, wl$sub_window))
  win_fct <- function(ev, id) factor(sw_lab[paste(ev, id)], levels = unique(wl$Winter[order(wl$event, wl$k)]))
  cat(paste0("\n\nPer-winter sub-windows: one launch, one pair of runs per unit; each fit group's window ",
             "(each country's under per-country season ends) cut into consecutive sub-windows, the k-th ending ",
             "with the cholera season containing the k-th winter's peak plus the group's largest positive deployed ",
             "lag. The sub-windows partition the event window, so their AN add up to the event's; AF do not.\n\n"))
  emit(sw$windows |>
         mutate(Event = ev_fct(event), Winter = win_fct(event, sub_window),
                val = sprintf("%s – %s", format(start, "%Y-%m"), format(end, "%Y-%m"))) |>
         report_wide(c("Event", "Winter"), "key", "val"),
       "Per-winter sub-windows of a multi-winter event: start – end by fit group (or country)",
       pack_by = "Event", slug = "D13_event_attrib_sub_window_bounds", raw = sw$windows)
  emit(hl_e(sw_all) |> filter(level != "country") |>
         mutate(Event = ev_fct(event), Winter = win_fct(event, sub_window),
                Scope = ifelse(level == "continent", "Africa", region),
                val = sprintf("%s | AF %s", fmt_an(metric, an, an_lo, an_hi), fmt_af(af, af_lo, af_hi)),
                col = paste(metric, FS_LAB[factual_source], sep = ", ")) |>
         arrange(Event, Winter) |>
         report_wide(c("Event", "Winter", "Scope"), "col", "val"),
       "ENSO-attributable cases and onsets per winter of a multi-winter event, Africa + by ENSO group: AN | AF, both factual readings (intervals as for the events)",
       pack_by = "Event", slug = "D13_event_attrib_sub_windows", raw = sw_all)
  if (!is.null(eam$sub_windows))
    emit(eam$sub_windows$scope |> filter(level != "country") |>
           mutate(Event = ev_fct(event), Winter = win_fct(event, sub_window),
                  Scope = ifelse(level == "continent", "Africa", scope),
                  val = sprintf("%s [obs %s]", fmt_pct_ci(af_mean, af_lo, af_hi, 1),
                                ifelse(metric == "onsets", fmt_num(observed, 0), fmt_cases(observed)))) |>
           arrange(Event, Winter) |>
           report_wide(c("Event", "Winter", "Scope"), "metric", "val"),
         "Analytic attributable fraction per winter of a multi-winter event (deployed crossbasis on the observed rows)",
         pack_by = "Event", slug = "D17_event_af_model_sub_windows", raw = eam$sub_windows$scope)
  if (nzchar(TABLES_DIR)) {
    note_caption("D13_event_attrib_sub_windows_af_adm1", "Past-event attribution per ADM1 and per-winter sub-window: as D13_event_attrib_af_adm1, one row per sub-window")
    report_write_csv(sw$af_adm1, file.path(TABLES_DIR, "D13_event_attrib_sub_windows_af_adm1.csv"))
    note_caption("D16_event_attrib_sub_windows_observed", "Past-event attribution per scope and per-winter sub-window, with the observed total: AN and AF as in D13 plus the observed total, its coverage and AN_obs = AF x observed")
    report_write_csv(sw$an_observed, file.path(TABLES_DIR, "D16_event_attrib_sub_windows_observed.csv"))
    if (!is.null(eam$sub_windows)) {
      note_caption("D17_event_af_model_sub_windows_adm1", "Analytic attribution of the past events per ADM1 and per-winter sub-window: as D17_event_af_model_adm1, one row per sub-window")
      report_write_csv(eam$sub_windows$adm1, file.path(TABLES_DIR, "D17_event_af_model_sub_windows_adm1.csv"))
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
#| label: s-season-ends
#| results: asis
gl <- R_("results_group_labels")
mon_abb <- function(m) ifelse(is.na(m), "—", month.abb[m])
cat(sprintf(paste0(
  "Each country's cholera-year end is its modal gid `min_seas` − 1 (the month before its cholera year ",
  "starts; ties go to the later end month), from the gid calendar of `%s`. Hindcast windows: %s; ",
  "past-event windows: %s (by_group = one season-end month per fit group, by_country_from_panel = each ",
  "country's own). The calendar-default column (countries whose every gid fell back to the January ",
  "default) is %s.\n\n"),
  gl$season_end_source$panel %||% "—", gl$season_end_mode$hindcast, gl$season_end_mode$event,
  if (is.na(gl$season_end_source$min_seas_source_csv)) "not available until 03_prepare_occ.R writes its .min_seas_source.csv"
  else "from the survival panel's .min_seas_source.csv"))
emit(gl$season_ends |>
       arrange(match(enso_group, GROUP_DISP$order), iso3) |>
       transmute(`ENSO group` = enso_group, Country = iso3, `Season end` = mon_abb(season_end_month),
                 `Modal min_seas` = mon_abb(min_seas_mode), `Modal share` = fmt_pct(modal_share),
                 Gids = fmt_int(n_gid), `Distinct min_seas` = fmt_int(n_distinct),
                 `Group season end (former)` = mon_abb(group_season_end_month),
                 `Calendar default` = ifelse(is.na(calendar_default), "—",
                                             ifelse(calendar_default, "yes", "no"))) |>
       with_afro("Country"),
     "Per-country cholera-season ends from the pipeline's season calendar (Data S1, D3)",
     pack_by = "ENSO group", slug = "D3_season_ends", raw = with_afro(gl$season_ends, "iso3", raw = TRUE))
for (wt in intersect(c("hindcast", "event"), unique(gl$season_windows$window_type))) {
  w <- filter(gl$season_windows, window_type == wt)
  emit(w |> arrange(match(enso_group, GROUP_DISP$order), iso3) |>
         mutate(val = format(firm_horizon_end, "%Y-%m"),
                enso_group = factor(enso_group, levels = GROUP_DISP$order)) |>
         report_wide(c("enso_group", "iso3"), "window", "val",
                     rename = c(`ENSO group` = "enso_group", Country = "iso3")) |>
         with_afro("Country"),
       sprintf("Firm window end per country and %s (Data S1, D3; season ends and unit horizons in the CSV)",
               if (wt == "hindcast") "hindcast launch year" else "past ENSO event"),
       pack_by = "ENSO group", slug = sprintf("D3_season_windows_%s", wt), raw = with_afro(w, "iso3", raw = TRUE))
}
```

```{r}
                    "gate was %s%s."),
             gt$scope, gt$rhat_max, gt$ess_min, gt$rhat_any, gt$max_divergent, gt$ebfmi_min, gt$action,
```

## Model specification of the deployed fits

Read from the deployed fit objects themselves (09's report_model_spec, in the
convergence step's fit load): the formula terms, random-effect grouping factors,
offsets, family and priors, checked against the documented term set
(`analysis/model_terms_deployed.yml`).

```{r}
#| label: s-model-spec
#| results: asis
MS <- setNames(lapply(FIG1_TRACKS, function(t) R_("results_report_model_spec", track = t)), FIG1_TRACKS)
ms_fits <- bind_rows(lapply(MS, `[[`, "fits"))
emit(ms_fits |>
       transmute(Track = track, `ENSO group` = enso_group, Lag = lag, Response = response,
                 Family = paste0(family, " (", link, ")"), `Fixed terms` = n_fixed, `RE terms` = n_re,
                 `RE groups` = re_groups, Offsets = offsets, Coefficients = n_fixef, Priors = n_priors,
                 `As documented` = ifelse(is.na(matches_deployed_terms), "n/a",
                                          ifelse(matches_deployed_terms, "yes", "NO"))),
     "Fit-level specification of the deployed models: one row per fit (Data S1, D25; terms, priors and the per-item check against model_terms_deployed.yml in the CSVs)",
     pack_by = "Track", slug = "D25_model_spec", raw = ms_fits)
ms_bad <- bind_rows(lapply(MS, `[[`, "check")) |> filter(!ok)
if (nrow(ms_bad))
  emit(ms_bad |> transmute(Track = track, `ENSO group` = enso_group, Item = item, Missing = missing, Unexpected = unexpected),
       "Deployed fits that differ from model_terms_deployed.yml", pack_by = "Track")
if (nzchar(TABLES_DIR)) {
  note_caption("D25_model_spec_terms", "Model terms of every deployed fit: one row per track x ENSO group x term (component and kind of term)")
  report_write_csv(bind_rows(lapply(MS, `[[`, "terms")), file.path(TABLES_DIR, "D25_model_spec_terms.csv"))
  note_caption("D25_model_spec_priors", "Priors of every deployed fit as brms reports them: one row per track x ENSO group x prior class / coefficient / group (source user or default)")
  report_write_csv(bind_rows(lapply(MS, `[[`, "priors")), file.path(TABLES_DIR, "D25_model_spec_priors.csv"))
  note_caption("D25_model_spec_check", "Check of every deployed fit against the declared term set (analysis/model_terms_deployed.yml): one row per track x ENSO group x item, expected and found terms, ok flag")
  report_write_csv(bind_rows(lapply(MS, `[[`, "check")), file.path(TABLES_DIR, "D25_model_spec_check.csv"))
}
```

## ENSO lag selection

```{r}
#| label: s-r8
#| results: asis
lg <- R_("results_report_lags")
cat(sprintf("Selection rule: `%s` (se_mult %s, occurrence floor offset %s).\n\n",
            lg$rule$rule, lg$rule$se_mult, lg$rule$occ_floor_offset %||% "none"))
dse <- function(d, se) ifelse(is.na(d), "—", sprintf("%s ± %s", fmt_num(d, 1), fmt_num(se, 1)))
lag_d <- function(l, d, se) ifelse(is.na(l), "—", sprintf("%d (%s)", l, dse(d, se)))
# The floor offset is meant to be the median whole-month episode span: cite
# the span stamped on the duration panel (S1 cascade), not a claim.
dur_span <- function(m) {
  cs <- d$cascade
  v <- if (is.null(cs)) numeric(0) else cs$value[cs$step == "03_prepare_dur" & cs$metric == m]
  if (length(v)) v[[1]] else NA_real_
}
floor_span_txt <- if (is.null(lg$rule$occ_floor_offset)) "" else
  if (is.na(dur_span("median_span_months")))
    "; offset vs the episode span: not stamped on the duration panel (03_prepare_dur.R --restamp)" else
  sprintf("; offset %s vs the median whole-month episode span %s months, IQR %s–%s (duration panel stamp, D1)",
          lg$rule$occ_floor_offset, fmt_num(dur_span("median_span_months"), 0),
          fmt_num(dur_span("span_months_q25"), 0), fmt_num(dur_span("span_months_q75"), 0))
emit(lg$selected |>
       transmute(Track = track, `ENSO group` = enso_group, `Deployed lag` = deployed_lag,
                 `Rule pick` = selected_lag, `Rank-1 lag` = rank1_lag,
                 `Δelpd (deployed)` = fmt_num(elpd_diff_deployed, 1),
                 `SE` = fmt_num(se_diff_deployed, 1), Lags = n_lags,
                 Floor = ifelse(is.na(floor_lag), "none", as.character(floor_lag)),
                 `Floor binds: cost` = ifelse(bound_active %in% TRUE, dse(bound_cost, bound_cost_se), "no"),
                 `Rank-2 lag (Δelpd)` = lag_d(rank2_lag, elpd_diff_rank2, se_diff_rank2),
                 `Best lag ≥ 0 (Δelpd)` = lag_d(best_nonneg_lag, elpd_diff_nonneg, se_diff_nonneg),
                 `k > 0.7 (deployed)` = ifelse(is.na(n_k_gt07_deployed), "—", fmt_int(n_k_gt07_deployed))) |>
       with_pmax("ENSO group", "group"),
     paste("Selected ENSO lags (negative = lead) and their elpd difference to the best lag; the deploy floor",
           paste0("(min_lag, and occ lag − offset downstream", floor_span_txt, "),"),
           "whether the best lag lies below it and the paired elpd cost,",
           "the rank-2 lag and the best non-negative lag (Δelpd ± SE to rank 1; Data S1, D6)"),
     pack_by = "Track", slug = "D6_selected_lags",
     # group_label: the group's display short name (style.group_labels; "GW"
     # under centroid) beside the stored id, which relab() maps to its label.
     raw = lg$selected |> mutate(group_label = unname(GROUP_DISP$short[enso_group]), .after = enso_group))
# Firm-horizon rule: the legacy table when the firm ONI end is
# the last CFSv2 month (or the artefact predates the field), else a firm ONI
# end column and the seam rule in the caption.
firm_seam_rule <- !is.null(lg$horizons$firm_oni_end) &&
  !identical(lg$horizons$firm_oni_end, lg$horizons$last_cfsv2_month)
h_tbl <- lg$horizons |>
  transmute(`ENSO group` = enso_group, `Lag occ` = best_lag_occ, `Lag dur` = best_lag_dur,
            `Lag mon` = best_lag_mon, `Min lag` = min_lag, `Last CFSv2 month` = last_cfsv2_month,
            `Firm horizon` = horizon_end, Countries = n_countries)
if (firm_seam_rule)
  h_tbl <- h_tbl |> mutate(`Firm ONI end` = lg$horizons$firm_oni_end, .before = `Firm horizon`)
emit(h_tbl,
     if (firm_seam_rule)
       "Firm forecast horizons: last full-ONI month (last CFSv2 target month − 1) + the shortest selected lag (Data S1, D6)"
     else "Firm forecast horizons: last CFSv2 target month + the shortest selected lag (Data S1, D6)",
     slug = "D6_firm_horizons", raw = lg$horizons)
emit(lg$ranking |>
       arrange(track, enso_group, single_lag) |>
       transmute(Track = track, `ENSO group` = enso_group, Lag = single_lag, Rank = rank,
                 `elpd_loo` = fmt_num(elpd_loo, 1), `Δelpd` = fmt_num(elpd_diff, 1),
                 SE = fmt_num(se_diff, 1), Selected = ifelse(selected, "\u2713", "")),
     "LOO lag rankings, lags -11..11 (Data S1, D7)",
     pack_by = "Track", slug = "D7_lag_loo_ranking", raw = lg$ranking)
```

### Pareto-k and averaging over lags

```{r}
#| label: s-r8-avg
#| results: asis
LA_CFG <- RES$derivation$lag_averaging %||% list()
la_path <- function(t) makeResultsRunFile(opt, "results_lag_averaging", track = t,
                                          schema = RESULTS_SCHEMA[["lag_averaging"]], config_path = CONFIG_PATH)
LA <- if (isTRUE(LA_CFG$enable)) Filter(Negate(is.null), lapply(setNames(FIG1_TRACKS, FIG1_TRACKS), function(t)
  if (file.exists(la_path(t))) R_("results_lag_averaging", track = t) else NULL)) else list()
if (!length(LA)) {
  cat(if (isTRUE(LA_CFG$enable))
    "*No lag_averaging artefact yet: it needs the 05 lag sidecars (05_fit_postprocess_loo_lags.R --lag_sidecar).*\n\n"
    else "*results.derivation.lag_averaging.enable is false: no lag averaging.*\n\n")
} else {
  lal <- bind_rows(lapply(LA, `[[`, "lags")); lai <- bind_rows(lapply(LA, `[[`, "irr"))
  lam <- bind_rows(lapply(LA, `[[`, "meta"))
  thr <- LA_CFG$k_threshold %||% 0.7; wmin <- LA_CFG$report_min_weight %||% 0.01
  cat(sprintf(paste0(
    "Every single-lag fit's PSIS-LOO from the 05 lag sidecars. The k-robust difference drops the rows with ",
    "Pareto k > %s at any lag (%s rows per group, median) and re-finds rank 1 on the rest. Weights: stacking ",
    "(main) and pseudo-BMA+ over every lag (`all`, the headline sensitivity: free of the selection rule and of ",
    "the deploy floor) and over the lags the deploy rule can pick (`eligible`); only the population ERF and ",
    "its IRR at the ENSO conditions are averaged.\n\n"), thr, fmt_int(stats::median(lam$n_dropped_k))))
  emit(lal |> arrange(track, enso_group, single_lag) |>
         transmute(Track = track, `ENSO group` = enso_group, Lag = single_lag,
                   `Δelpd ± SE` = dse(elpd_diff, se_diff),
                   `Δelpd k-robust ± SE` = dse(elpd_diff_krobust, se_diff_krobust),
                   !!sprintf("k > %s", thr) := fmt_int(k_flag), `k > 1` = fmt_int(n_k_gt1),
                   `Max k` = fmt_num(k_max, 2),
                   Role = paste0(ifelse(deployed, "deployed ", ""), ifelse(rank1, "rank 1 ", ""),
                                 ifelse(rank2, "rank 2", ""))),
       "Pareto-k diagnostics and elpd differences to the best lag, all and k-robust, per lag (Data S1, D8)",
       pack_by = "Track", slug = "D8_lag_pareto", raw = lal)
  wcols <- grep("^w_", names(lal), value = TRUE)
  wl <- lal |> select(track, enso_group, single_lag, deployed, all_of(wcols)) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(all_of(wcols), names_to = "w", values_to = "weight") |>
    filter(weight >= wmin) |>
    mutate(w = sub("^w_", "", w))
  emit(wl |> mutate(val = sprintf("%d%s: %s", single_lag, ifelse(deployed, "*", ""), fmt_num(weight, 2))) |>
         group_by(track, enso_group, w) |> summarise(val = paste(val, collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop") |>
         report_wide(c("track", "enso_group"), "w", "val", rename = c(Track = "track", `ENSO group` = "enso_group")),
       sprintf("Lag weights ≥ %s per method × lag set (* = deployed lag; Data S1, D9)", wmin),
       pack_by = "Track", slug = "D9_lag_weights", raw = lal |> select(track, enso_group, single_lag, deployed,
                                                                       all_of(wcols)))
  roles <- bind_rows(lapply(LA, `[[`, "roles"))
  cmp <- lai |>
    left_join(tidyr::pivot_wider(roles, names_from = role, values_from = single_lag), by = c("track", "enso_group")) |>
    filter((variant == "lag" & (single_lag == deployed | single_lag == rank2)) |
             (variant == "mixture" & method == "stacking")) |>
    mutate(what = case_when(variant == "mixture" ~ paste0("stacked (", lag_set, ")"),
                            single_lag == deployed ~ paste0("deployed (", single_lag, ")"),
                            TRUE ~ paste0("rank 2 (", single_lag, ")")),
           val = sprintf("%s P>1 %s", fmt_irr(irr, irr_lo, irr_hi), fmt_pct(p_gt1)),
           enso_label = cond_fct(enso_label))
  emit(cmp |> arrange(track, enso_group, what) |>
         report_wide(c("track", "enso_group", "what"), "enso_label", "val",
                     rename = c(Track = "track", `ENSO group` = "enso_group", ERF = "what")),
       "Population IRR at the ENSO conditions: deployed lag vs stacked over lags vs rank-2 lag (median, 95% CrI, P(IRR > 1); Data S1, D9)",
       pack_by = "Track", slug = "D9_lag_weights_irr", raw = cmp)
}
```

## Membership uncertainty of the deployed classes

```{r}
#| label: s-membership
#| results: asis
if (!is.null(MB)) {
  ct <- MB$country
  cat(sprintf(paste0(
    "Deployed sweep cell **%s**, agreeing chains %s. p_max = a country's largest posterior class probability; ",
    "%d of %d fitted countries have p_max < %s (†). The membership-weighted effects: M1 inside the latent-class ",
    "model (sum over classes of r × the class's El Niño contrast / lag centre, vs the hard MAP class), M2 over the ",
    "deployed group ERFs (sum over groups of r × the group's population ERF at its deployed lag)%s. The sweep ",
    "comparison is descriptive (country-block PSIS-LOO; high Pareto k expected).\n\n"),
    MB$cell, MB$agreeing, sum(ct$p_max < MB_LOW, na.rm = TRUE), sum(!ct$carried_over), fmt_num(MB_LOW, 2),
    if (length(MB$m2_skipped_tracks)) sprintf(" -- M2 not yet derived for %s (needs the 05 lag sidecars)",
                                              paste(MB$m2_skipped_tracks, collapse = ", ")) else ""))
  rc <- grep("^r_", names(ct), value = TRUE)
  mat <- ct |> arrange(match(group, GROUP_DISP$order), desc(p_max)) |>
    mutate(across(all_of(rc), ~ fmt_num(.x, 2)), p_max = pmax_lab(iso3),
           group = factor(group, levels = GROUP_DISP$order))
  names(mat)[match(rc, names(mat))] <- relab(sub("^r_", "", rc))
  emit(mat |> select(`ENSO group` = group, Country = iso3, `p_max` = p_max, all_of(relab(sub("^r_", "", rc))),
                     `Prior group` = prior_group) |> with_afro("Country"),
       "Responsibility matrix of the deployed classes: posterior class probabilities per country (agreeing chains; Data S1, D5)",
       pack_by = "ENSO group", slug = "D5_membership_matrix", raw = with_afro(ct, "iso3", raw = TRUE))
  emit(MB$group |> mutate(group = factor(group, levels = GROUP_DISP$order)) |> arrange(group) |>
         transmute(`ENSO group` = group, `Hard members` = n_hard, `Carried over` = n_carried_over,
                   `Soft size Σ r` = fmt_num(soft_size, 1), `Median p_max` = fmt_num(p_max_median, 2),
                   `Min p_max` = fmt_num(p_max_min, 2),
                   !!sprintf("p_max < %s", fmt_num(MB_LOW, 2)) :=
                     vapply(as.character(group), function(g) sum(ct$group == g & ct$p_max < MB_LOW, na.rm = TRUE), 0L)),
       "Membership summary per deployed class (Data S1, D5)", slug = "D5_membership_group", raw = MB$group)
  emit(MB$stability |> filter(id == MB$cell) |>
         transmute(Chains = chains, Draws = fmt_int(n_draws), `ARI mean` = fmt_num(ari_mean, 2),
                   `ARI 95%` = sprintf("%s–%s", fmt_num(ari_q2.5, 2), fmt_num(ari_q97.5, 2)),
                   `P(ARI = 1)` = fmt_pct(p_ari1), `Countries moved (mean, 97.5%)` =
                     sprintf("%s, %s", fmt_num(moved_mean, 1), fmt_num(moved_q97.5, 0))),
       "Partition stability: partitions sampled from the responsibilities vs the MAP (Data S1, D5)",
       slug = "D5_membership_stability", raw = MB$stability)
  emit(MB$sensitivity |> arrange(chains, desc(elpd_diff)) |>
         transmute(Chains = chains, Cell = id, ARI = fmt_num(ari, 2),
                   `Agree (label / matched)` = sprintf("%d / %d of %d", n_agree_label, n_agree_matched, n_countries),
                   `Δelpd vs deployed ± SE` = sprintf("%s ± %s", fmt_num(elpd_diff, 1), fmt_num(se_diff, 1)),
                   `k > 0.7 (cell / deployed)` = sprintf("%d / %d", n_k07, n_k07_deployed),
                   `Stacking weight` = fmt_num(stacking_weight, 2), Moved = moved),
       "Sensitivity of the deployed partition to the sweep cell and chain set (descriptive country-block elpd; Data S1, D5)",
       pack_by = "Chains", slug = "D5_membership_sensitivity", raw = MB$sensitivity)
  m1 <- MB$mixture_m1 |> filter(quantity == "kcon") |> left_join(select(ct, iso3, group), by = "iso3") |>
    mutate(group = factor(group, levels = GROUP_DISP$order)) |> arrange(group, iso3)
  emit(m1 |> transmute(`ENSO group` = group, Country = iso3, p_max = pmax_lab(iso3),
                       `Mixture contrast (95%)` = sprintf("%s (%s, %s)", fmt_num(mix_mean, 2), fmt_num(mix_q2.5, 2),
                                                          fmt_num(mix_q97.5, 2)),
                       `MAP class contrast` = fmt_num(map_mean, 2), `Mixture − MAP` = fmt_num(diff_mean, 2)) |>
         with_afro("Country"),
       "M1: membership-weighted El Niño contrast (log RR) inside the latent-class model vs the hard MAP class (Data S1, D5)",
       pack_by = "ENSO group", slug = "D5_membership_mixture_m1", raw = with_afro(MB$mixture_m1, "iso3", raw = TRUE))
  if (!is.null(MB$mixture_m2)) {
    m2 <- MB$mixture_m2 |> left_join(select(ct, iso3, group), by = "iso3") |>
      mutate(enso_label = cond_fct(enso_label), val = sprintf("%s P>1 %s", fmt_irr(irr, irr_lo, irr_hi), fmt_pct(p_gt1)),
             group = factor(group, levels = GROUP_DISP$order))
    emit(m2 |> arrange(track, group, iso3, erf) |>
           report_wide(c("track", "group", "iso3", "erf"), "enso_label", "val",
                       rename = c(Track = "track", `ENSO group` = "group", Country = "iso3", ERF = "erf")) |>
           with_afro("Country"),
         "M2: membership-weighted deployed ERFs (sum over groups of r × the group's population ERF at its deployed lag) vs the hard deployed group, IRR at the ENSO conditions (Data S1, D5)",
         pack_by = "Track", slug = "D5_membership_mixture_m2", raw = with_afro(MB$mixture_m2, "iso3", raw = TRUE))
  } else cat("*M2 needs the 05 lag sidecars (05_fit_postprocess_loo_lags.R --lag_sidecar).*\n\n")
} else cat("*results.kl_sweep_dir / results.kl_sweep_cell unset: no membership tables.*\n\n")
```

## WHO dashboard term: per-country scale

The smoothing scores the WHO dashboard national monthly count against the
simulated count of the covered gids times a per-country multiplier
(scale / who_f, who_f = covered population share). Under
`simulator.filter.who_obs.scale_mode: estimated` the scale is calibrated per
country on the months both the WHO table and the database observe (shrunk to
the pooled ratio, clamped), so the multiplier is the WHO/DB ratio W / D; a
legacy (fixed-scale) smoothing shows the implied ratios as a preview, while
the filter scored 1 / who_f (Data S1, D30; `D30_who_scale.csv`).

```{r}
#| label: s-who-scale
#| results: asis
WS <- tryCatch(R_("results_report_who_scale"), error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(WS)) {
  t36 <- WS$table
  emit(t36 |> arrange(country) |>
         transmute(Country = country, `who_f` = fmt_num(who_f, 2), Months = est_months,
                   `WHO cases` = fmt_int(who_cases), `DB cases` = fmt_int(db_cases),
                   `WHO/DB` = fmt_num(ratio_raw, 2), Scale = fmt_num(scale, 2),
                   `Multiplier (scored)` = fmt_num(multiplier_scored, 2), Source = source,
                   `WHO>0, DB=0` = months_who_pos_db_zero, `DB>0, WHO=0` = months_db_pos_who_zero) |>
         with_afro("Country"),
       sprintf("WHO dashboard term per country (%s; Data S1, D30)",
               if (identical(WS$mode, "estimated")) "estimated scale, as scored"
               else "legacy run: implied ratios, the filter scored 1 / who_f"))
  note_caption("D30_who_scale", "WHO dashboard term per country: who_f, WHO and database cases, scale and scored multiplier")
  if (nzchar(TABLES_DIR)) report_write_csv(with_afro(t36, "country", raw = TRUE), file.path(TABLES_DIR, "D30_who_scale.csv"))
  if (nzchar(TABLES_DIR) && !is.null(WS$national_monthly)) {
    note_caption("D36_who_national_monthly", "WHO national monthly series of suspected cases (dashboard weekly counts and situation-report differences): one row per country x month; cases, days covered (n_days), partial month flag and source")
    report_write_csv(WS$national_monthly, file.path(TABLES_DIR, "D36_who_national_monthly.csv"))
  }
  if (!is.null(WS$posterior))
    emit(WS$posterior, "WHO months inside / above / below the smoothing's 95% band (08c posterior check; Data S1, D30)")
} else cat("*report_who_scale artefact absent (results.inputs.smoothing_parts_dir unset or not derived).*\n\n")
```

## Counterfactual ENSO analog sets

```{r}
#| label: s-analog-sets
#| results: asis
# report_analog_sets v2 (v2 adds run_design, D34): the Lenssen analog pools the
# counterfactual runs sampled from. An artefact not derived yet is said, not
# an error.
AS <- tryCatch(R_("results_report_analog_sets"), error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(AS)) {
  cat(paste0(
    "Analog pools of the ENSO counterfactual (piControl, Lenssen et al. 2024): per arm (the forecast; each past ",
    "event) and analog set, the number of trajectories, the share of the largest model, the seam error (mean ",
    "launch-month ONI of the set minus the observed ONI there, °C) and the mean of every classified DJF ",
    "(the mean of the monthly ONI over December–February). `mixed` = a trajectory whose other classified ",
    "winters are not all neutral (kept in `all`). Sets under the minimum size are flagged.\n\n"))
  # Only when a cache relaxes its later winters (an event registry's
  # other_winters: any), so the text is unchanged otherwise.
  if (any(AS$winters$role %in% "read_unconstrained"))
    cat(paste0(
      "Winters with role `read_unconstrained` are read by the reported months and listed with their mean, ",
      "but constrain no set: the event's registry entry constrains only its own winters.\n\n"))
  emit(AS$sets |>
         transmute(Arm = arm, Matcher = match, Launch = launch, `Primary DJF` = primary_winter,
                   `Classified DJFs` = constrained_winters, Set = set, n = fmt_int(n),
                   `Share of pool` = fmt_pct(share_of_pool), Models = n_models,
                   `Largest model share` = sprintf("%s (%s)", fmt_pct(max_model_share), top_model),
                   `Seam error (°C)` = fmt_num(seam_error, 2),
                   `< min size` = ifelse(below_min_set_size, sprintf("yes (< %d)", min_set_size), "")),
       "Counterfactual analog sets per arm and set (Data S1, D29)",
       pack_by = "Arm", slug = "D29_analog_sets", raw = AS$sets)
  emit(AS$winters |>
         transmute(Arm = arm, Set = set, DJF = winter, Role = role, `Mean DJF ONI (°C)` = fmt_num(mean_djf_oni, 2)),
       "Mean DJF ONI of each classified winter per counterfactual analog set (Data S1, D29)",
       pack_by = "Arm", slug = "D29_analog_sets_winters", raw = AS$winters)
  emit(AS$model_shares |> transmute(Arm = arm, Set = set, Model = model, Share = fmt_pct(share)),
       "Model shares of each counterfactual analog set (Data S1, D29)",
       pack_by = "Arm", slug = "D29_analog_sets_models", raw = AS$model_shares)
} else cat("*report_analog_sets not derived yet (run 09 step report_analog_sets).*\n\n")
```

## Episodes with a confirmed case vs all episodes (GitHub, D40 / D40b)

```{r}
#| label: s-confirmed-agreement
#| results: asis
# Supplementary table (report_confirmed_agreement), on the analysis
# set: ENSO contrasts vs neutral of the three tracks, all episodes and those
# with a confirmed case, over the confirmed onsets' window (stable CSV
# D40_confirmed_agreement.csv: one row per block x set x track x contrast, with
# the block's onsets by phase and the window), and the within-country ratios of
# episode characteristics, confirmed / other (D40b_confirmed_characteristics.csv,
# with the coverage counts). The supplement formats both.
if (.art_exists("results_report_confirmed_agreement")) {
  CA <- R_("results_report_confirmed_agreement")
  ca <- CA$long |>
    # n_neutral is already on the long rows (the set's neutral onsets)
    left_join(CA$counts |> select(row, set, n_nina, n_elnino), by = c("row", "set")) |>
    mutate(window_start = CA$window[["start"]], window_end = CA$window[["end"]])
  ch <- CA$characteristics
  cat(sprintf(paste0("Confirmed cases reported for %d of %d episodes in %d of %d countries. Onsets %s to %s; ",
                     "a confirmed contrast needs %d neutral and %d phase onsets; sign differs in %d of %d ",
                     "computed confirmed contrasts, %d with an interval excluding 1.\n\n"),
              ch$coverage$n_confirmed, ch$coverage$n_episodes, ch$coverage$n_countries_confirmed,
              ch$coverage$n_countries, CA$window[["start"]], CA$window[["end"]], CA$cfg$min_neutral,
              CA$cfg$min_phase, sum(ca$sign_differs & ca$set == "conf"), sum(!is.na(ca$est) & ca$set == "conf"),
              sum(ca$sign_differs_ci & ca$set == "conf")))
  chr <- ch$ratios |> mutate(n_episodes_all = ch$coverage$n_episodes, n_confirmed_all = ch$coverage$n_confirmed,
                             n_countries_all = ch$coverage$n_countries,
                             countries_confirmed = paste(sprintf("%s %d", ch$countries$country, ch$countries$n_confirmed),
                                                         collapse = ", "))
  emit(chr |> transmute(Variable = variable, `Ratio, confirmed / other [95% CI]` =
                          sprintf("%s [%s, %s]", fmt_num(est, digits = 2), fmt_num(lo, digits = 2), fmt_num(hi, digits = 2)),
                        Episodes = n_episodes, Confirmed = n_confirmed, Countries = n_countries),
       "Episodes with a confirmed case vs other episodes of the reporting countries: within-country ratios (D40b)",
       slug = "D40b_confirmed_characteristics", raw = chr)
  note_caption("D40_confirmed_agreement",
               "ENSO contrasts vs neutral of occurrence, duration and monthly cases, all episodes and those with a confirmed case")
  if (nzchar(TABLES_DIR)) report_write_csv(ca, file.path(TABLES_DIR, "D40_confirmed_agreement.csv"))
  note_caption("D40c_confirmed_characteristics_by_block",
               "Within-country ratio, confirmed / other, of suspected cases and duration, by Africa, group and country")
  if (nzchar(TABLES_DIR)) report_write_csv(CA$characteristics_by_block,
                                           file.path(TABLES_DIR, "D40c_confirmed_characteristics_by_block.csv"))
} else cat("*report_confirmed_agreement not derived: D40 not written.*\n\n")
```

## Supplementary tables T1–T5

The supplementary tables: T1 the ENSO-rainfall
link per ENSO group (T1a literature, T1b this pipeline's rainfall and the deployed
cholera lags), T2 the LOO comparison across ENSO lags, T3 the country effects
with the fitted-range flag, T4 / T5 the attributable fractions of past events and
of the 2026 forecast as wide views. Every number is read from a phase-09
artefact; T1a is curated text (`results.inputs.enso_rain_mechanisms`, copied into the
rain_enso artefact by 09).

```{r}
#| label: s-wishlist-t1
#| results: asis
RAIN <- tryCatch(R_("results_rain_enso"), error = function(e) NULL)
# A signed lag ("−6", "+7", "0"; results_core.R::group_lag_signed()), "—" when missing.
lag_txt <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "—", group_lag_signed(x))
.reg <- load_grouping(GROUP_META$source)
T_MEMBERS <- split(as.character(.reg$iso3), as.character(.reg$group))
if (!is.null(RAIN$mechanisms)) {
  t1a <- report_t1a_mechanisms(RAIN$mechanisms, T_MEMBERS, GROUP_DISP$order)
  emit(t1a |> transmute(`ENSO group` = enso_group,
                        Members = ifelse(nzchar(members_note), sprintf("%s (%s)", members, members_note), members),
                        `Main rainy season(s)` = season, `Stage of the ENSO cycle` = stage,
                        `Main ENSO-rainfall lag` = main_lag, `El Niño signal` = el_nino_signal,
                        Mechanism = mechanism, References = references) |>
         mutate(`ENSO group` = factor(`ENSO group`, levels = GROUP_DISP$order)),
       paste("T1a. Main ENSO-rainfall link in the rainy season by ENSO group, from the literature (lag L:",
             "rainfall in month t vs ONI at t − L, L > 0 = ENSO leads; curated, no estimate)"),
       slug = "T1a_enso_rain_mechanisms", raw = t1a)
} else cat("*rain_enso not derived or results.inputs.enso_rain_mechanisms unset: no T1a.*\n\n")
LG_T <- tryCatch(R_("results_report_lags"), error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(RAIN) && !is.null(LG_T)) {
  t1b <- report_t1b_rain_lags(RAIN, LG_T$selected, GROUP_DISP$order, "pop")
  emit(t1b |> transmute(`ENSO group` = factor(enso_group, levels = GROUP_DISP$order),
                        `Rainy season (pop.-weighted)` = rainy_season,
                        `Strongest in-season r (month, lag, r)` =
                          ifelse(is.na(best_r), "—", sprintf("%s, L %s, r %s%s", best_centre_month, lag_txt(best_lag),
                                                              sprintf("%+.2f", best_r),
                                                              ifelse(!is.na(best_p) & best_p < 0.001, " (p < 0.001)",
                                                                     sprintf(" (p %s)", fmt_num(best_p, 3))))),
                        `Season-mean r peak (lag, r)` =
                          ifelse(is.na(season_mean_peak_r), "—", sprintf("L %s, r %+.2f", lag_txt(season_mean_peak_lag),
                                                                         season_mean_peak_r)),
                        `Deployed cholera lag occ / dur / mon` =
                          sprintf("%s / %s / %s", lag_txt(lag_occ), lag_txt(lag_dur), lag_txt(lag_mon))),
       sprintf(paste("T1b. Rainfall-ONI correlation in the rainy season by ENSO group (CHIRPS ADM1 3-month rainfall",
                     "deviation vs lagged ONI, lags %d..%d, baseline %s; Pearson r, no interval) and the deployed cholera",
                     "lags (report_lags)"), min(RAIN$lags), max(RAIN$lags), paste(RAIN$baseline, collapse = "–")),
       slug = "T1b_enso_rain_lags", raw = t1b)
} else cat("*rain_enso or report_lags not derived: no T1b.*\n\n")
```

## Seasonality against the rainy season

Supplementary fig. SE: per ENSO group, the
calendar month at which each track peaks, observed and fitted, against the
group's main rainy season (the Fig. 1d months, population-weighted). Observed
peaks skip months with fewer than `min_n` events; the duration model's fitted
peak is shown only when its deployed fits carry the calendar harmonics
(duration.seasonal_term harmonic2). The monthly table behind the figure is Data S1, D37.

```{r}
#| label: s-seasonality
#| results: asis
SE_ART <- tryCatch(R_("results_seasonality"), error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(SE_ART)) {
  pk <- SE_ART$peaks
  cell <- function(g, t, s) {
    r <- pk[pk$enso_group == g & pk$track == t & pk$source == s, , drop = FALSE]
    if (!nrow(r) || is.na(r$peak_month[1])) return("—")
    sprintf("%s (%s, %+.1f)", month.abb[r$peak_month[1]], if (isTRUE(r$in_rainy[1])) "in" else "out",
            r$lag_from_rain[1])
  }
  dur_fit <- any(pk$track == "cessation" & pk$source == "fitted")
  grp <- intersect(GROUP_DISP$order, unique(SE_ART$rain$enso_group))
  rainy <- vapply(grp, function(g) pk$rainy_months[pk$enso_group == g][1] %||% "none", "")
  t_se <- tibble::tibble(enso_group = grp, rainy_season = unname(rainy),
                         onset_obs = vapply(grp, cell, "", "occurrence", "observed"),
                         onset_fit = vapply(grp, cell, "", "occurrence", "fitted"),
                         cessation_obs = vapply(grp, cell, "", "cessation", "observed"),
                         cessation_fit = vapply(grp, cell, "", "cessation", "fitted"),
                         cases_obs = vapply(grp, cell, "", "cases", "observed"),
                         cases_fit = vapply(grp, cell, "", "cases", "fitted"))
  emit(t_se |> transmute(`ENSO group` = factor(enso_group, levels = GROUP_DISP$order),
                         `Rainy season` = rainy_season, `Onsets, observed` = onset_obs,
                         `Onsets, fitted` = onset_fit, `Cessation, observed` = cessation_obs,
                         `Cessation, fitted` = cessation_fit,
                         `Cases, observed` = cases_obs, `Cases, fitted` = cases_fit) |>
         (\(t) if (dur_fit) t else dplyr::select(t, -`Cessation, fitted`))(),
       sprintf(paste("Peak calendar month of each track by ENSO group (in / out: inside or outside the group's",
                     "rainy season; signed lag in months from the centre of the nearest rainy season, positive =",
                     "after it). Observed peaks skip months with fewer than %d events; fitted = the occurrence",
                     "model's seasonal spline and the %s"), SE_ART$meta$min_n,
               if (dur_fit) "duration and monthly models' calendar harmonics"
               else "monthly model's harmonics (no seasonal term in the duration model)"),
       slug = "seasonality_peaks", raw = dplyr::mutate(SE_ART$peaks, min_n = SE_ART$meta$min_n))
  if (nzchar(TABLES_DIR)) {
    obs <- SE_ART$rates |>
      tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = c(enso_group, month), names_from = track,
                         values_from = c(rate, lo, hi, n, sparse), names_glue = "{track}_{.value}")
    fit <- SE_ART$fitted |>
      tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = c(enso_group, month), names_from = track,
                         values_from = c(rel, lo, hi), names_glue = "{track}_fitted_{.value}")
    d37 <- SE_ART$rain |>
      dplyr::transmute(enso_group, month, rain_mm = mm, rainy_season = in_season) |>
      dplyr::left_join(obs, by = c("enso_group", "month")) |>
      dplyr::left_join(fit, by = c("enso_group", "month")) |>
      dplyr::arrange(factor(enso_group, levels = GROUP_DISP$order), month)
    note_caption("D37_seasonality", paste(
      "Monthly seasonality by ENSO group (the supplementary seasonality figure): population-weighted rainfall climatology (mm) and rainy-season",
      "flag; observed onsets per 1,000 at-risk unit-months, episode ends per 100 active episode-months and median",
      "cases per active episode-month, with interval (Poisson 95% / IQR), event count and sparse flag; fitted",
      if (dur_fit) "relative seasonality of the occurrence, duration and monthly models"
      else "relative seasonality of the occurrence and monthly models"))
    report_write_csv(d37, file.path(TABLES_DIR, "D37_seasonality.csv"))
  }
} else cat("*seasonality artefact not derived: no seasonality table.*\n\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: s-wishlist-t2
#| results: asis
if (!is.null(LG_T) && is.null(LG_T$loo_summary))
  stop("[11] report_lags has no loo_summary (schema v3): re-run 09 step report_lags.", call. = FALSE)
if (!is.null(LG_T)) {
  # Derived in 09 (report_lags v3 loo_summary, report_lags_loo_summary()).
  SE_MULT_T2 <- as.numeric(LG_T$loo_summary$se_mult[1])
  t2 <- LG_T$loo_summary |>
    mutate(track = TRACK_FCT(track), enso_group = factor(enso_group, levels = GROUP_DISP$order)) |>
    arrange(track, enso_group)
  dse1 <- function(d, se) ifelse(is.na(d), "—", sprintf("%s (%s)", fmt_num(d, 1), fmt_num(se, 1)))
  emit(t2 |> transmute(Track = track, `ENSO group` = enso_group, `Rank-1 lag` = lag_txt(rank1_lag),
                       `Deployed lag` = lag_txt(deployed_lag),
                       `Deployed vs rank 1` = ifelse(deployed_lag == rank1_lag, "0", dse1(deployed_elpd_diff, deployed_se_diff)),
                       `Rank 2: lag, Δelpd` = ifelse(is.na(rank2_lag), "—", sprintf("%s: %s", lag_txt(rank2_lag), dse1(rank2_elpd_diff, rank2_se_diff))),
                       `Lag 0` = ifelse(rank1_lag == 0L, "0 (rank 1)", dse1(lag0_elpd_diff, lag0_se_diff)),
                       `Worst: lag, Δelpd` = sprintf("%s: %s", lag_txt(worst_lag), dse1(worst_elpd_diff, worst_se_diff)),
                       !!sprintf("Lags within %s SE", fmt_num(SE_MULT_T2, 0)) := sprintf("%d / %d", n_within_se, n_lags),
                       `elpd_loo (SE), rank 1` = dse1(elpd_loo_rank1, se_elpd_rank1),
                       `p_loo, rank 1` = fmt_num(p_loo_rank1, 1)),
       paste("T2. PSIS-LOO comparison of the single-lag fits by track and ENSO group: Δelpd (SE of the paired",
             "difference) to the rank-1 lag of the same cell; elpd values compare within a cell only",
             "(no no-ENSO reference fit)"),
       pack_by = "Track", slug = "T2_lag_loo_summary", raw = t2)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: s-wishlist-t3
#| results: asis
# T3: country effects per track (report_effects v6), "§" on a condition outside
# the group's fitted ONI range; WHO-AFRO subregion and p_max columns.
T3_LETTER <- c(occurrence = "a", duration = "b", monthly = "c")
for (trk in FIG1_TRACKS) {
  ec <- EFF[[trk]]$effects_country
  if (is.null(ec) || !nrow(ec)) next
  if (!all(c("range_lo", "range_hi") %in% names(ec))) { ec$range_lo <- NA_real_; ec$range_hi <- NA_real_ }
  bl <- EFF[[trk]]$best_lag
  ec <- ec |> mutate(outside_range = report_outside_range(enso_val, range_lo, range_hi),
                     deployed_lag = bl$best_lag[match(enso_group, bl$enso_group)])
  n_out <- sum(ec$outside_range)
  emit(report_wide(mutate(ec, enso_label = cond_fct(enso_label),
                          lag = lag_txt(deployed_lag),
                          val = paste0(fmt_ratio_bold(IRR, IRR_lo, IRR_hi, 2), ifelse(outside_range, RANGE_MARK, ""))),
                   c("region", "lag", "country"), "enso_label", "val", levels = list(region = LV$region),
                   rename = c(`ENSO group` = "region", `Deployed lag` = "lag", Country = "country")) |>
         with_afro("Country") |> with_pmax("Country"),
       sprintf(paste("T3%s. %s — ENSO effect by country at each ENSO condition vs neutral (posterior median, 95%% CrI;",
                     "bold = CrI excludes 1; %s = condition outside the group's fitted ONI range, %d cell(s)%s)"),
               T3_LETTER[[trk]] %||% "", trk, RANGE_MARK, n_out,
               if (all(is.na(ec$range_lo))) "; range not in this report_effects artefact" else ""),
       pack_by = "ENSO group", slug = sprintf("T3%s_effects_country_%s", T3_LETTER[[trk]] %||% "", trk),
       raw = ec |> with_afro("country", raw = TRUE) |>
         mutate(p_max = if (is.null(MB)) NA_real_ else MB$country$p_max[match(country, MB$country$iso3)]))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: s-wishlist-t4-t5
#| results: asis
# T4: past-event AF, ENSO group rows x event columns, one table per metric (the
# r4-events slice: factual source, analog set and explosive mode as there).
if (exists("ev_af") && !is.null(ev_af) && nrow(ev_af)) {
  for (m in c("cases", "onsets")) {
    x <- filter(ev_af, metric == m)
    emit(x |> mutate(val = fmt_af(af, af_lo, af_hi)) |>
           report_wide("Scope", "Event", "val"),
         sprintf("T4%s. Attributable fraction of %s per past ENSO event — Africa + by ENSO group (%s; bold = interval excludes 0; %s)",
                 c(cases = "a", onsets = "b")[[m]], c(cases = "cases", onsets = "outbreak onsets")[[m]], INT_LAB, EXPL_LAB),
         slug = sprintf("T4%s_event_af_%s", c(cases = "a", onsets = "b")[[m]], m),
         raw = x |> mutate(Event = as.character(Event), Scope = as.character(Scope)))
  }
} else cat("*No past-event attribution in this config: no T4.*\n\n")
# T5: forecast AF wide views of the attribution metrics (am_af, s-am): T5a the
# windows side by side (main analog set), T5b the analog sets side by side
# (headline window); explosive mode as the headline.
if (exists("am_af") && !is.null(am_af) && nrow(am_af)) {
  t5 <- am_af |> filter(explosive_guard == HL_GUARD) |>
    mutate(Scope = scope_fct(scope_lab(level, as.character(scope))), val = fmt_af(af, af_lo, af_hi),
           metric = factor(metric, levels = c("cases", "onsets")))
  t5a <- filter(t5, analog_set == MAIN_SET) |> mutate(col = paste0(metric, ": ", window))
  emit(t5a |> mutate(col = factor(col, levels = unique(col[order(metric, match(window, names(WIN_LAB)))]))) |>
         report_wide("Scope", "col", "val"),
       sprintf("T5a. Attributable fraction of the 2026 forecast by attribution window — Africa + by ENSO group (counterfactual set %s; %s; windows: %s)",
               MAIN_SET, INT_LAB, paste(sprintf("%s = %s", names(WIN_LAB), WIN_LAB)[names(WIN_LAB) %in% t5a$window], collapse = "; ")),
       slug = "T5a_forecast_af_windows", raw = filter(am_af, analog_set == MAIN_SET, explosive_guard == HL_GUARD))
  t5b <- filter(t5, window == HL_WIN) |>
    mutate(analog_set = factor(analog_set, levels = unique(c(SETS, sort(unique(analog_set))))))
  emit(t5b |> arrange(metric, Scope) |> report_wide(c("metric", "Scope"), "analog_set", "val",
                                                    rename = c(Metric = "metric")),
       sprintf("T5b. Attributable fraction of the 2026 forecast by counterfactual analog set — Africa + by ENSO group (window %s; main set %s; %s)",
               WIN_LAB[[HL_WIN]] %||% HL_WIN, MAIN_SET, INT_LAB),
       pack_by = "Metric", slug = "T5b_forecast_af_sets", raw = filter(am_af, window == HL_WIN, explosive_guard == HL_GUARD))
} else cat("*No forecast attribution metrics: no T5.*\n\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: data-release

# Each D / T CSV goes to the Supplementary Data (supp) or to the
# repository's data folder (github) by results.style.data_release; the manifest
# lists every file with its release and caption.
if (nzchar(TABLES_DIR) && length(DATA_RELEASE)) {
  REL_MAN <- report_release_split(TABLES_DIR, DATA_RELEASE,
                                  unlist(mget(ls(.CAPTIONS), envir = .CAPTIONS)),
                                  exclude = DATA_RELEASE_EXCLUDE)
  cat(sprintf(paste0("%d D / T tables released: %d to `%s/supp_data/` (Supplementary Data), %d to `%s/github/` ",
                     "(GitHub data folder), %d withheld; manifest `%s/data_release_manifest.csv`%s.\n\n"),
              sum(REL_MAN$release %in% c("supp", "github")), sum(REL_MAN$release == "supp"), TABLES_DIR,
              sum(REL_MAN$release == "github"), TABLES_DIR, sum(REL_MAN$release == "withheld"), TABLES_DIR,
              if (any(!nzchar(REL_MAN$release)))
                sprintf("; not in the release map: %s", paste(unique(REL_MAN$data_id[!nzchar(REL_MAN$release)]),
                                                             collapse = ", ")) else ""))
} else cat("*results.style.tables_dir or results.style.data_release unset: no data release split.*\n\n")
```
